canonical_title: Anzu and the Tablet of Destinies
title_zh: 安祖与命运泥板
summary_zh: 安祖夺走命运泥板，宁努尔塔在叙事中成为获胜者并取回泥板；依据 ORACC 的学术数字展览纲要。
summary_en: Anzu steals the Tablet of Destinies; Ninurta becomes the victorious hero and recovers it, according to the registered ORACC scholarly synopsis.
themes_json: ["命运泥板","安祖","宁努尔塔","夺回"]
editorial_note: 学术纲要阅读版，不假装是完整泥板翻译。

canonical_title: The Epic of Gilgamesh: the king who sought eternal life
title_zh: 吉尔伽美什史诗：寻找永生的国王
summary_zh: 乌鲁克的国王吉尔伽美什三分之二是神、三分之一是人，他压迫百姓，众神便用泥土造出野人恩奇都与他匹敌。两人摔跤后结为挚友，一起杀死雪松林的守护者胡姆巴巴，又拒绝伊什塔尔的求爱、杀死天牛。众神判恩奇都必须死去。失去朋友的吉尔伽美什害怕死亡，穿过黑暗的山路、渡过死亡之水，找到洪水中幸存的乌特纳皮什提，听他讲述大洪水的故事。他没能通过不睡觉的考验，得到的返老还童仙草又被蛇偷走，最后回到了乌鲁克的城墙下。
summary_en: Gilgamesh, king of Uruk, two-thirds god and one-third man, oppresses his people, so the gods make the wild man Enkidu from clay to match him. After wrestling they become friends, kill Humbaba of the Cedar Forest, spurn Ishtar and slay the Bull of Heaven. The gods decree Enkidu's death. Terrified of dying, Gilgamesh crosses the mountains and the Waters of Death to Uta-napishti, survivor of the Flood, who tells him the Flood story. He fails the test of sleep, loses the plant of rejuvenation to a snake, and comes home to the walls of Uruk.
themes_json: ["吉尔伽美什", "友谊", "死亡", "大洪水", "长篇"]
editorial_note: 依据 eBL 的标准巴比伦版综合文本（第一至十一块泥板）；泥板有残缺，残缺处只按综合本概述，第十二块泥板（苏美尔诗的译本）作为附录不讲。

canonical_title: Marduk and Tiamat
title_zh: 马尔杜克与提亚马特
summary_zh: 《埃努玛·埃利什》的登记层确认马尔杜克与提亚马特参与创世战斗；本版先提供证据导读，不把未逐条录入的战斗细节写成结构化事实。
summary_en: The registered layer of Enuma elish confirms Marduk and Tiamat in the creation combat; this version is an evidence guide and does not promote unmodeled details to structured fact.
themes_json: ["创世","战斗","巴比伦","王权"]
editorial_note: 待电子巴比伦图书馆各泥板逐行拆分后扩充。

canonical_title: Nezha conquers the sea — the lotus rebirth in Investiture of the Gods
title_zh: 哪吒闹海：《封神演义》里的莲花化身
summary_zh: 陈塘关总兵李靖的夫人怀胎三年六个月，生下一个肉球，球里跳出戴着乾坤圈、裹着混天绫的哪吒。七岁那年，他在九湾河洗澡震动东海龙宫，打死夜叉和龙王三太子敖丙；又在宝德门外痛打东海龙王，误射死石矶娘娘的徒弟。四海龙王捉走他的父母，哪吒剖腹剜肠、剔骨还父、割肉还母。太乙真人用莲花为他重造身体，哪吒追杀李靖，直到燃灯道人赐下玲珑宝塔。
summary_en: Lady Yin, wife of Li Jing of Chentang Pass, carries her child for three years and six months and gives birth to a ball of flesh, from which springs Nezha wearing a golden ring and a red sash. At seven he shakes the Dragon King's palace while bathing, kills a patrolling yaksha and the dragon prince Ao Bing, beats the Dragon King at the gate of heaven and accidentally kills an immortal's disciple. When the dragon kings seize his parents, he returns his flesh and bones to them; his teacher Taiyi rebuilds him from lotus, and he hunts his father until Li Jing receives a golden pagoda.
themes_json: ["哪吒", "闹海", "莲花化身", "长篇", "明代小说"]
editorial_note: 明代小说属于后世文学接受层；按回目顺序独立讲述，现代影视改编不合并。

canonical_title: Fuxi makes the eight trigrams
title_zh: 伏羲始作八卦
summary_zh: 《周易·系辞下》说：古时包牺氏（伏羲）治理天下，他抬头观察天象，低头观察地理，看鸟兽身上的纹理和各地的物产，近取自身、远取万物，于是开始画出八卦；他又把绳子打结做成网，用来打猎捕鱼。
summary_en: The Xi Ci II says that when Baoxi (Fuxi) ruled in antiquity, he looked up at heaven and down at the earth, studied the markings of birds and beasts and the land, drew on his own body and on distant things, and first made the eight trigrams; he also knotted cords into nets for hunting and fishing.
themes_json: ["伏羲", "八卦", "文明起源"]
editorial_note: 依据《系辞下》第二章；“包牺即伏羲”采用传统注疏的读法。

canonical_title: Gonggong strikes Mount Buzhou — two early witnesses
title_zh: 共工触不周山：天倾西北的两处见证
summary_zh: 《淮南子·天文训》把共工与颛顼争帝、怒触不周山写成独立的天地倾斜起源；《列子·汤问》则用“其后”把同一事件接在女娲补天之后。两处见证都不把它写成女娲补天的起因。
summary_en: Huainanzi “Tian Wen” narrates Gonggong contending with Zhuanxu and striking Mount Buzhou as a standalone explanation of why heaven and earth tilt; Liezi “Tang Wen” attaches the same event after Nüwa's repair with “afterwards”. Neither witness makes it the cause of Nüwa's repair.
themes_json: ["共工","不周山","天倾西北","起源解释"]
editorial_note: 事件位置差异进入显式冲突档案；不周山不投射为现实坐标，颛顼不作历史真实性判断。

canonical_title: The Yellow Emperor and Chiyou at Zhuolu
title_zh: 黄帝战蚩尤：涿鹿之战
summary_zh: 《史记·五帝本纪》说：神农氏衰落，诸侯互相攻伐，轩辕操练军队征讨不服者。蚩尤最为暴虐，作乱不听帝命。轩辕征召诸侯之兵，在涿鹿的原野擒杀蚩尤，诸侯于是尊他为天子，这就是黄帝。
summary_en: The Shiji's Annals of the Five Emperors say that as Shennong's house declined and the lords fought one another, Xuanyuan trained troops. Chiyou, the most violent, rebelled against the ruler's command; Xuanyuan levied the lords' armies, captured and killed him in the wilds of Zhuolu, and was honoured as Son of Heaven — the Yellow Emperor.
themes_json: ["黄帝", "蚩尤", "战争", "上古帝王"]
editorial_note: 依据《史记·五帝本纪》；司马迁以史笔叙述，本站只登记文本所述，不作历史真实性断言。

canonical_title: Leigong: the Han image of the thunder god and Wang Chong's rebuttal
title_zh: 雷公：汉代人画中的雷神与王充的反驳
summary_zh: 东汉思想家王充在《论衡·雷虚》里，记下了他那个时代人们对雷的种种看法，然后一一加以反驳。当时的人们相信：雷电劈断大树、毁坏房屋，是上天来取龙；雷电打死人，是因为那人有不为人知的过错，比如给人吃了不干净的食物，上天发怒，就用雷把他打死，隆隆的雷声就是天发怒的声音。画工们画雷的样子，是一串连在一起的鼓，又画一个像力士一样的人，叫做雷公，左手拉着连鼓，右手举着槌子，像在敲打的样子。王充指出，雷公既然没有翅膀，就不可能在天上飞；他又举出五条证据，说明雷其实是火：被雷击死的人须发烧焦、皮肤灼伤，尸体上有火的气味；雷电能烧毁房屋草木。他认为，雷是盛夏时阳气与阴气相争而激发出来的气，就像把水泼进冶炼的炉火里会发出巨响一样。
summary_en: In the 'Lei Xu' ('Thunder: the Falsehood') chapter of his Lunheng, the Eastern Han thinker Wang Chong records the beliefs of his day about thunder and refutes them one by one. People believed that when thunder split trees and wrecked houses, Heaven was taking a dragon; when it killed a man, it was punishing a hidden fault — feeding people unclean food, say — and Heaven in its anger struck him dead, the rumbling being the sound of Heaven's wrath. Painters drew thunder as a string of linked drums, and beside them a man like a strongman, called Leigong, the Thunder Lord, pulling the drums with his left hand and raising a mallet in his right as if to strike. Wang Chong points out that Leigong, having no wings, could not fly in the sky; and he gives five proofs that thunder is really fire: those killed by it have singed hair and burned skin and smell of fire, and lightning burns houses and plants. Thunder, he argues, is the energy thrown off when yang and yin contend in high summer, just as water poured on a smelting fire bursts with a roar.
editorial_note: 依据王充《论衡·雷虚》按论述顺序讲述，引用的古文只作为讲述的依据，正文用白话。这一篇是汉代人关于雷神信仰与绘画的重要见证，可它是王充为了反驳而记录的，所以本篇同时讲出当时的信仰与王充的批评，不替任何一方下结论；《山海经》雷泽雷神与后世道教、民间的雷部诸神另有记录，不并入。

canonical_title: The thunder spirit of Leize
title_zh: 《山海经》雷泽雷神片段
summary_zh: 《山海经·海内东经》记下雷泽中的无名雷神，并把雷声与其击腹相连；此形象不自动等同后世雷公。
summary_en: The Hai Nei Dong Jing records an unnamed thunder spirit in Leize and connects thunder with striking its belly; this figure is not automatically identified with later Leigong.
themes_json: ["山海经","雷泽","雷神","文本片段"]
editorial_note: 保留原段落范围与后世身份区分。

canonical_title: Nezha against Sun Wukong (Journey to the West, ch. 4)
title_zh: 哪吒大战孙悟空：《西游记》第四回
summary_zh: 孙悟空嫌弼马温官小，回花果山自称齐天大圣。托塔李天王与哪吒三太子奉命捉拿。哪吒变出三头六臂，悟空也变三头六臂；悟空拔毫毛变出分身，真身绕到背后打中哪吒，哪吒负痛败走。
summary_en: Finding his stable post too lowly, Sun Wukong returns home and calls himself Great Sage Equal to Heaven. Heavenly King Li and his third son Nezha are sent to seize him. Nezha takes three heads and six arms; Wukong does the same, then turns a hair into a double and strikes Nezha from behind, and Nezha retreats in pain.
themes_json: ["哪吒", "孙悟空", "变化", "明代小说"]
editorial_note: 明代小说《西游记》属于后世文学接受层，不当作古代神话见证；哪吒闹海等故事出自其他作品，未在此合并。

canonical_title: Nüwa repairs the sky — Huainanzi and Liezi witnesses
title_zh: 女娲补天：《淮南子》与《列子》两种见证
summary_zh: 《淮南子·览冥训》与《列子·汤问》都记载女娲炼五色石、断鳌足立四极；前者另有黑龙与芦灰，后者把补天放在天地“物有不足”的问答里，并在其后才引出共工。两份见证分开阅读，不合成后世“共工撞山导致女娲补天”的版本。
summary_en: Huainanzi “Lan Ming” and Liezi “Tang Wen” both have Nüwa refine five-colored stones and cut a turtle's legs to set up the four poles; the former adds the black dragon and reed ash, while the latter frames the repair as a remedy for deficient things and introduces Gonggong only afterwards. The two witnesses are read separately and are not merged into the later version in which Gonggong's collision causes the repair.
themes_json: ["女娲","补天","宇宙修复","见证分离"]
editorial_note: 两份传世文献逐段并列；《列子》传世本成书年代有争议，不据此排序。后世因果化的复述作为独立接受层排队。

canonical_title: Pangu between heaven and earth
title_zh: 盘古开天地：《三五历纪》佚文
summary_zh: 三国吴人徐整的《三五历纪》已经失传，只在后世类书中留有引文。《艺文类聚》卷一引它说：天地未分时混沌如鸡蛋，盘古生在其中；一万八千年后天地开辟，清者为天、浊者为地；天每天高一丈，地每天厚一丈，盘古每天长一丈，又过一万八千年，天极高、地极深、盘古极长。
summary_en: Xu Zheng's Sanwu liji is lost, surviving only in later encyclopedias. Yiwen leiju juan 1 quotes it: before heaven and earth parted, all was chaos like a hen's egg, and Pangu was born inside; after 18,000 years they opened, clear becoming heaven and murky becoming earth; each day heaven rose a zhang, earth thickened a zhang and Pangu grew a zhang, until after another 18,000 years heaven was highest, earth deepest and Pangu tallest.
themes_json: ["盘古", "创世", "天地开辟"]
editorial_note: 依据《艺文类聚》卷一所引《三五历纪》，并以《太平御览》卷一的引文对照；盘古身体化生万物另见他书，不在此合并。

canonical_title: Soushen ji: thirteen tales of the strange
title_zh: 搜神记选读：十三个志怪故事
summary_zh: 东晋史官干宝收集了许多关于神仙、鬼怪和奇异之事的记载，编成《搜神记》。本篇按卷次选读其中十三则：孝子董永卖身葬父，天上的织女下凡为他织绢还债；铸剑师干将被楚王杀害，儿子赤比把自己的头和剑交给一位侠客，侠客在汤镬中斩下楚王的头，三颗头煮在一起，葬为三王墓；范巨卿千里赴约，又在梦中得知亡友的葬期；东海孝妇蒙冤而死，鲜血逆流而上，郡中三年大旱；韩凭夫妇死后，两座坟上长出的梓树枝根相交，被称为相思树；嫦娥偷了不死药奔向月亮；少女戏言许嫁的马被杀，马皮卷走少女，化成了蚕；披着羽衣的女子被藏起衣服，嫁人生女，最后找回羽衣飞去；吴王之女紫玉相思而死，化为鬼魂与韩重相会；宋定伯骗过了一个鬼，把它当羊卖了；少女李寄带着剑和狗，斩杀了吞食少女的大蛇；义犬黑龙用湿透的身体扑灭野火，救了醉卧的主人。
summary_en: Gan Bao, a historian of the Eastern Jin, gathered accounts of immortals, ghosts and strange events into the Soushen ji, In Search of the Supernatural. This reading follows the juan in order through thirteen of its tales: the filial Dong Yong sells himself to bury his father, and the Weaving Maiden of heaven comes down to weave his debt away; the swordsmith Gan Jiang is killed by the king of Chu, and his son Chi Bi gives his own head and sword to a stranger, who beheads the king in a boiling cauldron so that the three heads are buried together as the Tomb of the Three Kings; Fan Juqing keeps a promise across a thousand li and learns in a dream of his dead friend's burial; a filial widow of Donghai dies unjustly, her blood flows up the pole and the commandery suffers three years of drought; from the graves of Han Ping and his wife grow catalpas whose roots and branches intertwine, the trees of longing; Chang'e steals the elixir and flees to the moon; a girl's jesting promise to a horse ends with the horse's hide carrying her off and both turning into silkworms; a woman in a feather robe, her robe hidden, marries and bears daughters, then finds it and flies away; Ziyu, princess of Wu, dies of longing and meets her beloved as a ghost; Song Dingbo outwits a ghost and sells it as a sheep; the girl Li Ji, with a sword and a dog, kills the serpent that devoured maidens; and the dog Black Dragon soaks itself to put out a fire around its drunken master.
editorial_note: 依据古腾堡计划所收《搜神记》二十卷本，按卷次选读十三则，用白话独立讲述。今本《搜神记》是后人从类书中辑录重编的，卷次与条目未必是干宝原书的面貌；东海孝妇一则中关于周青血溅竹竿的部分，原书标为“长老传云”的传说。

canonical_title: Journey to the West: three tries for the plantain fan
title_zh: 西游记 · 三调芭蕉扇
summary_zh: 秋天的路上越走越热，师徒被八百里火焰山挡住。只有翠云山铁扇公主的芭蕉扇能扇灭这火，可她是牛魔王的妻子、红孩儿的母亲，恨透了孙悟空。第一次借扇，悟空被一扇扇出五万里，吃了灵吉菩萨的定风丹再去，又钻进她肚里逼出一把扇子，却是假的，越扇火越旺。第二次，悟空变作牛魔王的模样骗到了真扇，却只学会了变大，不会变小。第三次，牛魔王变作猪八戒把扇子骗了回去，两人从变化斗到原形，八戒、土地、四大金刚、哪吒和托塔天王四面围捕，牛魔王终于归降。悟空连扇四十九扇，断了火根，师徒走过了火焰山。
summary_en: As autumn grows hotter, the pilgrims are blocked by eight hundred li of fire. Only Princess Iron Fan's plantain fan can put it out — but she is the Bull Demon King's wife and Red Boy's mother, and she hates Sun Wukong. On the first try her fan blows Wukong fifty thousand li; with Lingji's wind-fixing pill he returns, gets into her belly and forces out a fan — a false one that makes the fire worse. On the second, disguised as the Bull Demon King, he wins the real fan but only learns how to make it grow. On the third, the Bull Demon King, disguised as Bajie, tricks it back; they fight through transformations until Bajie, the local gods, the guardian kings, Nezha and Li Jing close in and the bull surrenders. Wukong fans forty-nine times to put out the fire for good, and the pilgrims cross.

editorial_note: 明代小说属于后世文学接受层；本站按维基文库所收版本的回目顺序独立讲述。小说中的火焰山与新疆吐鲁番真实的火焰山不是同一回事，本站分开登记。

canonical_title: The Monkey King: from the stone egg to Havoc in Heaven
title_zh: 美猴王：从石猴出世到大闹天宫
summary_zh: 《西游记》前七回的完整讲述：花果山仙石孕出石猴，他在水帘洞称王，又为躲避死亡漂洋求道，从须菩提祖师那里学会七十二变和筋斗云；回山后到龙宫取走如意金箍棒，在地府勾掉生死簿；天庭先封他弼马温、后封齐天大圣，他却偷吃蟠桃和金丹，打退十万天兵；最后被二郎神擒住，八卦炉炼出火眼金睛，终被如来压在五行山下。
summary_en: The full opening arc of Journey to the West: a stone on the Mountain of Flowers and Fruit gives birth to a monkey who becomes king of the Water Curtain Cave, crosses the seas to learn immortality, the seventy-two transformations and the somersault cloud, takes the iron staff from the Dragon King, strikes his name from the register of death, scorns heaven's offices, eats the peaches and elixir, defeats heaven's armies, survives the furnace with fiery golden eyes, and is finally pinned under the Mountain of Five Elements by Rulai.

canonical_title: Journey to the West: how the pilgrimage began
title_zh: 西游记 · 取经缘起：从灵山到长安
summary_zh: 大闹天宫之后，如来要把三藏真经传到东土，观音菩萨领命东行，一路上为未来的取经人点化了沙和尚、猪刚鬣、玉龙三太子和五行山下的孙悟空。长安这边，江流儿陈玄奘历尽身世之苦长大成僧；泾河龙王为了赌气私改雨数，被魏征梦中斩首，冤魂纠缠唐太宗，太宗魂游地府后还阳，决定举办水陆大会。观音在大会上显圣，说西天有大乘真经，玄奘领命成为“三藏”，带着一捻故乡土踏上西行之路。
summary_en: After Havoc in Heaven, the Buddha resolves to send his scriptures east, and Guanyin travels to find a pilgrim, recruiting on the way the future disciples Sha Wujing, Zhu Bajie, the jade dragon prince and the Monkey King under the mountain. In Chang'an the orphan Jiangliu grows up to be the monk Xuanzang; the Jing River dragon king breaks heaven's decree to win a bet and is beheaded in Wei Zheng's dream; Emperor Taizong visits the underworld and returns to hold a great mass for the dead. Guanyin appears at the mass, Xuanzang volunteers to fetch the scriptures, and he leaves with a pinch of home soil in his wine.

canonical_title: Journey to the West: the pilgrims come together
title_zh: 西游记 · 师徒聚首：从两界山到流沙河
summary_zh: 唐三藏出了长安，在双叉岭失去两个随从，靠太白金星和猎户刘伯钦才保住性命。到了两界山，他揭下压帖放出孙悟空，悟空打死六个强盗，被观音给的紧箍咒降服。之后鹰愁涧的玉龙吃了白马，被观音变成白龙马；观音禅院的老僧贪图袈裟纵火，袈裟又被黑风山的熊精偷走，悟空请观音收服了熊精。在高老庄，悟空降服了招赘的猪八戒；浮屠山乌巢禅师传授《心经》；黄风岭的黄风怪吹伤悟空的眼睛，灵吉菩萨定住了风魔；最后在八百里流沙河，木叉带来观音的葫芦，沙悟净用九个骷髅结成法船，师徒四众终于聚齐。
summary_en: Leaving Chang'an, Tang Sanzang loses his attendants at Double Fork Ridge and is saved by the planet Venus and the hunter Liu Boqin. At the Mountain of Two Frontiers he frees Sun Wukong, who kills six robbers and is tamed by the golden fillet. A dragon who ate the white horse becomes the White Dragon Horse; a greedy abbot burns his own temple for the cassock, a bear spirit steals it, and Guanyin subdues the bear. At Gao Village Wukong captures the pig-faced son-in-law Zhu Bajie; the Crow's Nest Chan master teaches the Heart Sutra; Lingji Bodhisattva stills the Yellow Wind demon; and at the Flowing Sands River Sha Wujing ferries the master across on a raft of nine skulls and a gourd.

canonical_title: Journey to the West: the real and the false Monkey King
title_zh: 西游记 · 真假美猴王
summary_zh: 孙悟空打死拦路的草寇，又杀了收留他们的杨老儿的儿子，唐僧念紧箍咒把他赶走。悟空无处可去，到落伽山向观音哭诉。这时一个一模一样的“孙悟空”打倒唐僧，抢走行李，在花果山另组了一支取经队伍。真假两个悟空从花果山打到南海，又打上天宫、闹到唐僧面前、打进阴司，观音的紧箍咒、玉帝的照妖镜、阎王的生死簿都分辨不出。地藏王的神兽谛听心里明白却不敢说破，最后到了雷音寺，如来说出世上有四种猴子不在十类之中，那假的是六耳猕猴。悟空一棒打死了他，观音送悟空回到唐僧身边。
summary_en: Sun Wukong kills a band of highwaymen and then the son of the old man who sheltered the pilgrims, and Tang Sanzang drives him away with the Tight-Fillet Spell. Wukong, with nowhere to go, weeps before Guanyin. Meanwhile an identical 'Wukong' knocks Sanzang down, steals the baggage and forms his own pilgrimage on the Mountain of Flowers and Fruit. The two Wukongs fight from the mountain to the Southern Sea, to heaven, before Sanzang and into the underworld; neither Guanyin's spell, the Jade Emperor's demon-revealing mirror nor the registers of the dead can tell them apart. The beast Diting knows but dares not say, and at Thunderclap Monastery the Buddha explains that there are four monkeys outside the ten categories of beings: the false one is a six-eared macaque. Wukong kills him and returns to his master.

canonical_title: Journey to the West: three blows against the White Bone Demon
title_zh: 西游记 · 三打白骨精
summary_zh: 白虎岭上的尸魔白骨夫人想吃唐僧肉，先后变成送饭的村姑、寻女的老妇、念经的老翁，三次都被孙悟空的火眼金睛识破打死。猪八戒在旁挑唆，唐僧认定悟空滥杀无辜，写下贬书把他赶回花果山。没有了悟空，唐僧在黑松林落入黄袍怪手中，又被这妖怪在宝象国变成了一只老虎；白龙马化作宫娥行刺失败，八戒只得上花果山请大师兄。悟空嘴硬心软，被八戒一激便下山救师，降服了原来是天上奎木狼星的黄袍怪，师徒重归于好。
summary_en: On White Tiger Ridge the corpse demon Lady White Bone tries three times to trick Tang Sanzang — as a village girl bringing food, an old woman seeking her daughter and an old man saying his beads — and three times Sun Wukong's fiery eyes see through her and he strikes her down. Egged on by Zhu Bajie, Sanzang believes Wukong has murdered innocents and banishes him with a written dismissal. Without him, Sanzang falls into the hands of the Yellow Robe Demon, who turns him into a tiger at the court of Baoxiang; the dragon horse fails in a disguised assassination, and Bajie must go to the Mountain of Flowers and Fruit. Goaded by Bajie, Wukong returns, unmasks the demon as the Kui Wolf star, and master and disciple are reconciled.

canonical_title: Khonsu's journey: the tale of the Bentresh Stela
title_zh: 孔苏远行：本特蕾什石碑的故事
summary_zh: 一块立在卡纳克孔苏神庙旁的石碑讲道：拉美西斯二世在那哈林接受各国的贡品，巴赫坦国王把长女献给了他，她成为王后奈芙鲁拉。后来巴赫坦派来信使，说王后的妹妹本特蕾什病了。国王派生命之屋的书吏前去，书吏发现公主被一个精灵附身，无能为力。巴赫坦国王再次求援，这一次要的是一位神。国王来到底比斯的“孔苏·奈弗尔霍特普”神像前，请他转向另一尊“驱邪者孔苏”，让驱邪者孔苏带着他的护佑远行巴赫坦。神像走了一年零五个月，一到公主身边，她立刻痊愈；附身的精灵向神致敬，请求与神和国王一同过节后离去。巴赫坦国王舍不得放神回去，把神像留了三年零九个月，直到梦见神化作一只金鹰飞向埃及，才把神像连同厚礼送回底比斯。
summary_en: A stela set up beside the temple of Khonsu at Karnak tells how Ramesses II, receiving tribute in Naharin, was given the eldest daughter of the prince of Bakhtan, who became Queen Neferure. Later a messenger came: the queen's younger sister Bentresh was ill. The king sent a scribe of the House of Life, who found the princess possessed by a spirit he could not overcome. The prince of Bakhtan asked again — this time for a god. The king went before Khonsu-in-Thebes-Neferhotep and asked him to turn to the image called Khonsu-the-Provider, who drives out disease demons, and send him to Bakhtan with his protection. The god travelled a year and five months; as soon as he reached the princess she was well, and the spirit greeted the god and asked for a feast with him and the prince before it departed. The prince, loath to let the god go, kept him three years and nine months, until he dreamed of the god flying as a golden falcon toward Egypt; then he sent the image back to Thebes with rich gifts.

editorial_note: 依据卢浮宫藏本特蕾什石碑（C 284）按碑文顺序讲述。石碑把故事放在拉美西斯二世时代，但它的语言和出土地点表明它写成于很晚的时期（波斯或托勒密时代，学界仍有争论），并没有拉美西斯时代的记载可以印证；本篇把它当作一个托古的宗教故事讲述，不作史实断言。“巴赫坦”在哪里也不确定。碑文中的年份与日期据现代学者的释读。

canonical_title: Daughter of Amun: the divine birth of Hatshepsut
title_zh: 阿蒙的女儿：哈特谢普苏特的神圣诞生
summary_zh: 在底比斯西岸代尔拜赫里的哈特谢普苏特神庙里，一组浮雕讲述了这位女法老的神圣出身。众神之王阿蒙-拉在众神面前宣布，他要生下一位未来的统治者；托特向他推荐了图特摩斯一世的王后雅赫摩斯，又引他来到王后的寝宫。阿蒙化作国王的模样，王后被神的香气唤醒，看见了神的真身，神为将要出生的女儿取名“与阿蒙结合的哈特谢普苏特”。阿蒙吩咐陶工之神克努姆在陶轮上塑造孩子和她的卡，蛙头女神赫凯特把生命之符递到她们面前。托特向王后报喜，克努姆和赫凯特领她走进产房，孩子诞生了。哈托尔把婴儿献给阿蒙，阿蒙称她为心爱的女儿和两地之王，众女神和神牛哺育她，托特把孩子和她的卡呈给阿蒙，众神为她定下了千百万年的寿命。
summary_en: In Hatshepsut's temple at Deir el-Bahari on the west bank of Thebes, a cycle of reliefs tells the divine origin of this woman king. Amun-Re, king of the gods, announces before the gods that he will beget a future ruler; Thoth commends to him Ahmose, queen of Thutmose I, and leads him to her chamber. Amun takes the king's form; the queen wakes at the god's fragrance and sees him in his true form, and the god names the coming daughter Khenemet-Amun Hatshepsut. Amun bids the potter god Khnum shape the child and her ka on his wheel, while the frog goddess Heqet holds out the sign of life. Thoth announces the birth to the queen, Khnum and Heqet lead her to the birth chamber, and the child is born. Hathor presents the infant to Amun, who greets her as his beloved daughter and king of the Two Lands; goddesses and divine cows nurse her; Thoth presents the child and her ka to Amun, and the gods fix her lifetime at millions of years.

editorial_note: 依据代尔拜赫里神庙中层柱廊北侧的诞生浮雕与题记，按画面顺序讲述；场景的划分与编号据现代学者（布鲁纳）的整理，本篇只标出能核对的编号。这组浮雕是宣扬王权合法性的宗教图像，不作史实断言；浮雕中哈特谢普苏特的形象在图特摩斯三世时被凿毁，阿蒙的形象在阿赫那吞时被破坏，部分题记残缺，残缺处不补写。

canonical_title: The Eye of Ra becomes Sekhmet — Tale of the Heavenly Cow
title_zh: 拉的眼睛化作塞赫麦特：天牛之书
summary_zh: 人类反叛太阳神拉。拉把自己的“眼睛”派出去惩罚人类，她化作塞赫麦特，几乎把人类消灭。众神把一湖啤酒染成血红色，她喝醉后恢复成慈爱的哈托尔。
summary_en: Humankind rebels against the sun-god Ra. He sends out his Eye to punish them; as Sekhmet she almost wipes humanity out, until the gods dye a lake of beer blood-red and she drinks, growing gentle again as Hathor.

canonical_title: From Atum to Horus — a family of Egyptian gods
title_zh: 从阿图姆到荷鲁斯：埃及众神的一家
summary_zh: UCL 数字埃及把零散的古代文献整理成一个神族谱系：太阳神阿图姆生出舒与泰芙努特，他们又生出大地之神盖布与天空女神努特；舒把天地分开。后来塞特杀害兄弟奥西里斯，伊西斯收集遗体并怀上荷鲁斯。这是一份学术综述，不是某一部古代文献的原文顺序。
summary_en: UCL Digital Egypt orders scattered ancient references into one divine family: the sun-god Atum brings forth Shu and Tefnet, who produce Geb (earth) and Nut (sky); Shu holds them apart. Later Seth murders his brother Osiris, and Isis gathers the body and conceives Horus. It is a scholarly synthesis, not the sequence of a single ancient text.

canonical_title: Ptah creates by heart and tongue: the Memphite Theology
title_zh: 普塔用心与舌创造世界：孟菲斯神学
summary_zh: 公元前八世纪，库施王朝的法老沙巴卡在孟菲斯的普塔神庙里发现一卷被虫蛀坏的古书，命人把它重新刻在一块石板上。石上的文字先讲大地之神盖布怎样裁决荷鲁斯与塞特之争：起初把埃及一分为二，后来把全部遗产都给了荷鲁斯，荷鲁斯在孟菲斯统一了两地，而孟菲斯的主神普塔被称为“塔特恩”，统一两地之王。接着是著名的“神学”部分：一切神都以普塔的形式出现，阿图姆是在普塔的心中和舌上成形的；心想出一切，舌说出一切，众神、城市、食物和一切技艺都由普塔的话语而生。普塔造完万物后安息了，众神进入用木、石、泥做成的身体里。最后讲奥西里斯在水中淹溺，伊西斯和奈芙蒂斯把他救上孟菲斯的岸边，他进入大地，荷鲁斯在父亲的怀抱中成为上下埃及之王。
summary_en: In the eighth century BCE the Kushite pharaoh Shabaka found in the temple of Ptah at Memphis an old book eaten by worms and had it carved anew on a stone slab. The text first tells how Geb, god of the earth, judged between Horus and Seth: at first he divided Egypt between them, then gave the whole inheritance to Horus, who united the Two Lands at Memphis — and Ptah, god of Memphis, is called Ta-tenen, the king who unites the land. Then comes the famous 'theology': all the gods appear as forms of Ptah, and Atum took shape in Ptah's heart and on his tongue; the heart conceives all and the tongue speaks all, and gods, towns, food and every craft come from Ptah's word. When he had made all things Ptah rested, and the gods entered bodies of wood, stone and clay. Last, Osiris is drowned in the water, Isis and Nephthys bring him ashore at Memphis, he enters the earth, and Horus becomes king of Upper and Lower Egypt in his father's arms.

editorial_note: 依据大英博物馆藏沙巴卡石（EA 498）按碑文顺序讲述。石板后来被当作磨盘使用，中间大片文字已经磨损，本篇只讲能读的部分，不补写残缺处。碑文说它是古书的复本，学者们对原文的年代意见不一，有人认为写于古王国，也有人认为就是第二十五王朝的作品；本篇不替它定年。

canonical_title: Two mourning goddesses — Isis and Nephthys
title_zh: 两位哀悼的女神：伊西斯与奈芙蒂斯
summary_zh: 大都会艺术博物馆的一对托勒密时期木像：奈芙蒂斯跪着，举手掩面哀悼；另一尊是同样姿势的伊西斯。博物馆说明，在古埃及的图像中，这两位女神常守在奥西里斯遗体的两侧。
summary_en: A Ptolemaic pair of wooden figures at the Met: Nephthys kneels with a hand raised before her face in mourning, and a companion figure shows Isis. The museum notes that the two mourning goddesses accompany the body of Osiris in Egyptian representations.

canonical_title: Public route of the Opet procession
title_zh: 奥佩特节的公开仪仗路线
summary_zh: 埃及文物主管部门的卢克索神庙档案记录：阿蒙、穆特和孔苏的神像由卡纳克出发，沿仪仗联系抵达卢克索神庙。本页只叙述可公开核对的路线与纪念物层。

canonical_title: Osiris and Isis: the long story as Plutarch told it
title_zh: 奥西里斯与伊西斯：普鲁塔克讲的长篇故事
summary_zh: 天空女神瑞亚（努特）被太阳诅咒不能在任何月份生产，赫尔墨斯（托特）从月亮那里赢来五天，众神才在这五个闰日里依次出生。奥西里斯做了埃及的国王，教人们耕种、立法和敬神，又走遍世界传播文明。他的弟弟提丰（塞特）带着七十二个同谋，用一只量身定做的木箱把他困死，扔进尼罗河。伊西斯剪下一绺头发，穿上丧服，一路寻找，在腓尼基的比布鲁斯从王宫的柱子里取回丈夫的棺木。提丰夜里打猎时又发现了遗体，把它撕成十四块撒遍埃及。伊西斯乘纸草船在沼泽里一块块找回，于是埃及到处都有奥西里斯的坟墓。最后，奥西里斯从冥界回来训练儿子荷鲁斯，荷鲁斯在漫长的战斗中打败了提丰。
summary_en: Cursed by the Sun so that she could not give birth in any month, Rhea (Nut) was saved when Hermes (Thoth) won five extra days from the Moon, and on them five gods were born. Osiris became king of Egypt, taught farming, law and worship, and civilised the world. His brother Typhon (Seth) and seventy-two conspirators trapped him in a made-to-measure chest and sent it down the Nile. Isis cut a lock of her hair, put on mourning and searched until she recovered the coffin from a pillar of the palace at Byblos. Typhon later found the body while hunting by moonlight and tore it into fourteen pieces; Isis gathered them in a papyrus boat, which is why Egypt has many tombs of Osiris. Osiris returned from the dead to train Horus, who defeated Typhon after a long war.

canonical_title: The Tale of Two Brothers: Bata, the Valley of the Pine and Pre-Harakhti
title_zh: 两兄弟的故事：巴塔、松树谷与拉-哈拉赫提
summary_zh: 阿努比斯和巴塔是一对亲兄弟，哥哥有家有妻，弟弟像儿子一样替他耕田放牛，连牛都会告诉他哪里的草最好。嫂子诱惑巴塔遭到拒绝，反诬他施暴，哥哥拿着长矛躲在牛棚门后要杀他，母牛们警告了巴塔。巴塔逃跑时向拉-哈拉赫提祈祷，太阳神在兄弟之间造出一条满是鳄鱼的河。天亮后巴塔说出真相，以自残明志，前往松树谷，把心放在松树的花上；哥哥回家杀了不忠的妻子。九柱神在松树谷遇见巴塔，拉-哈拉赫提命克努姆为他造了一个妻子，七位哈托尔却预言她将死于刀下。大海卷走她的一缕香发送到法老那里，法老派人把她接来，她泄露了巴塔的秘密，松树被砍倒，巴塔死去。哥哥看见啤酒起沫，找了三年才找到那颗心，把弟弟救活。巴塔先后化作公牛和两棵鳄梨树，最后借一片木屑重生为法老的儿子，登上王位，审判了妻子，让哥哥做了王储。
summary_en: Anubis and Bata are brothers; the elder has house and wife, and the younger works his fields and herds his cattle like a son — the cattle even tell him where the grass is best. The elder's wife tries to seduce Bata, is refused, and accuses him falsely; Anubis waits behind the byre door with a spear, and the cows warn Bata. Fleeing, Bata prays to Pre-Harakhti, who sets a water full of crocodiles between the brothers. At dawn Bata tells the truth, maims himself to prove it, and goes to the Valley of the Pine, placing his heart on the pine's flower; Anubis goes home and kills his faithless wife. The Ennead meets Bata in the valley, and Pre-Harakhti has Khnum fashion him a wife, though the Seven Hathors foretell she will die by the knife. The sea carries a scented lock of her hair to Pharaoh, who has her brought to him; she betrays Bata's secret, the pine is cut, and Bata dies. Anubis, seeing his beer froth, searches three years for the heart and revives his brother. Bata becomes a bull, then two persea trees, and at last, through a splinter, is reborn as Pharaoh's son, takes the throne, judges his wife and makes his brother crown prince.

canonical_title: Weighing the heart — Anubis and Thoth in the Papyrus of Ani

canonical_title: Kalevala, Part 3: Kullervo
title_zh: 卡勒瓦拉 · 第三部 库勒沃
summary_zh: 温塔莫与卡勒沃两兄弟因为一连串小事结下深仇，温塔莫杀光了卡勒沃的族人，只留下一个怀孕的女子做奴隶。她生下的库勒沃在摇篮里就发誓复仇。温塔莫三次想杀死他：把他装进桶里扔进湖中，扔进火堆，吊在橡树上，他都活了下来。温塔莫让他干活，他什么都干坏，最后被卖给铁匠伊尔马里宁做奴隶。伊尔马里宁的妻子让他去放牛，在他的面包里烤进一块石头，他父亲留下的唯一遗物——一把刀——在石头上折断了。库勒沃把狼和熊变成牛群赶回家，主妇在挤奶时被它们咬死。他逃进森林，找到了还活着的父母，却在替父亲交税回来的路上诱骗了一个少女，后来才知道她是自己失散多年的妹妹，妹妹投入急流而死。库勒沃出征，灭了温塔莫一族，回到家时亲人都已死去。他来到妹妹遇害的地方，问自己的剑是否愿意饮他的血，然后伏剑而死。
summary_en: The brothers Untamo and Kalervo fall into a deep feud over a run of petty quarrels; Untamo slays Kalervo's people, sparing only a pregnant woman as a slave. Her son Kullervo vows vengeance in the cradle. Untamo tries three times to kill him — in a barrel thrown into the lake, on a pyre, hanged from an oak — and each time he lives. Every task Kullervo is given he ruins, and at last he is sold as a slave to the smith Ilmarinen. Ilmarinen's wife sends him to herd the cattle and bakes a stone into his bread, on which his father's knife, the only keepsake of his kin, breaks. Kullervo drives home wolves and bears in the shape of cattle, and the mistress is killed as she milks. Fleeing, he finds his parents alive, but on his way home from paying his father's tax he seduces a maiden who proves to be his long-lost sister; she throws herself into the rapids. Kullervo goes to war, destroys Untamo's clan, and comes home to find his family dead. At the place where he wronged his sister he asks his sword whether it will drink his blood, and falls upon it.

canonical_title: Kalevala, Part 2: Lemminkäinen
title_zh: 卡勒瓦拉 · 第二部 勒明凯宁
summary_zh: 英俊而鲁莽的勒明凯宁从萨里岛抢走了少女基利基，两人立誓：他不再去打仗，她不再去村里跳舞。基利基破了誓，勒明凯宁就要到北方的波赫约拉去另求新娘。母亲苦苦相劝，他把梳子往墙上一掷，说：梳子流血的时候，就是我遭难的时候。他在波赫约拉用歌声赶走了所有的巫师，只放过了一个又老又瞎、被他嘲笑的牧人。洛希给他出了三道难题：滑雪追捕希西的麋鹿，给希西喷火的马套上笼头，射死图奥内拉黑河上的天鹅。前两件他都做到了，第三件时，那个盲眼牧人在河边用一条水蛇刺穿了他的心，把他抛进黑河，亡者之王的儿子把他砍成了碎块。家中的梳子流出了血。母亲赶到北方，从洛希和太阳那里问出真相，请铁匠打了一把长柄铜耙，从黑河里一块块捞出儿子的身体，缝合血脉，又派蜜蜂从九重天外取来神的蜜膏，终于让儿子活了过来。
summary_en: The handsome, reckless Lemminkäinen carries off the maiden Kyllikki from the island of Saari, and they vow — he never to go to war, she never to go dancing in the village. When she breaks her vow, he sets out for northern Pohjola to woo another. His mother begs him to stay; he flings his brush at the wall: when it bleeds, misfortune has befallen me. In Pohjola he sings all the sorcerers away but spares an old blind herdsman, whom he mocks. Louhi sets him three tasks: to catch the elk of Hiisi on skis, to bridle Hiisi's fire-breathing horse, and to shoot the swan on the black river of Tuonela. He does the first two; at the third, the blind herdsman pierces his heart with a water-serpent and throws him into the river, where the son of the lord of the dead hews him to pieces. At home the brush drips blood. His mother hurries north, learns the truth from Louhi and the sun, has the smith forge a long-handled copper rake, gathers her son's body piece by piece from the river, joins his veins, and sends a bee beyond the nine heavens for the Creator's honey, until her son lives again.

canonical_title: Kalevala, Part 1: the making of the world and the Sampo
title_zh: 卡勒瓦拉 · 第一部 创世与三宝
summary_zh: 大气之女伊尔玛塔尔降到海上，漂流了许多年代，一只鸭子在她的膝盖上下了蛋，蛋碎了，变成了大地、天空、太阳、月亮和星星。她的儿子万奈莫宁在母腹中待了三十个夏天，生下来就是老人。他播种森林与大麦，用歌声把来挑战的年轻歌手约卡海宁唱进沼泽；约卡海宁为了活命，把妹妹艾诺许给了他，艾诺却投海而死。万奈莫宁去北方的波赫约拉求亲，被约卡海宁射落海中，一只鹰把他带到北方。波赫约拉的女主人洛希答应送他回家，条件是为她锻造三宝。回程中他为彩虹上织布的少女造船，被斧头砍伤了膝盖，靠一位老人讲述铁的起源才止住了血。回到家乡，他用计把铁匠伊尔马里宁送到北方，伊尔马里宁锻造出了能磨出粮食与财富的三宝，少女却仍不肯嫁给他。
summary_en: Ilmatar, daughter of the air, descends to the sea and floats for ages; a duck lays eggs on her knee, and the broken eggs become earth, sky, sun, moon and stars. Her son Väinämöinen spends thirty summers in the womb and is born already old. He sows the forests and the barley, and sings the young challenger Joukahainen into a swamp; to save his life Joukahainen promises him his sister Aino, who drowns herself in the sea. Seeking a bride in the northern land of Pohjola, Väinämöinen is shot into the sea by Joukahainen and carried north by an eagle. Louhi, mistress of Pohjola, will send him home if the Sampo is forged for her. On the way he builds a boat for the maiden weaving on the rainbow, gashes his knee with his axe, and is healed by an old man once he has told the origin of iron. At home he tricks the smith Ilmarinen into going north, where Ilmarinen forges the Sampo that grinds grain and wealth — yet the maiden still refuses him.

canonical_title: Kalevala, Part 4: the theft of the Sampo
title_zh: 卡勒瓦拉 · 第四部 夺取三宝
summary_zh: 万奈莫宁、伊尔马里宁和勒明凯宁乘着一艘渴望出征的战船前往北方，去夺回为波赫约拉锻造的三宝。船在急流中卡在一条巨大的梭鱼背上，万奈莫宁杀死梭鱼，用它的颚骨做成了第一把康特勒琴。他的琴声让天上地下所有的生灵都来倾听，连他自己也流下了眼泪，泪水落进海里，变成了蓝色的珍珠。到了波赫约拉，洛希不肯分享三宝，万奈莫宁就用琴声把整个北方唱入梦乡。英雄们打开铜山的门锁，用牛犁断三宝的根，把它搬上船逃走。勒明凯宁忍不住在船上唱歌，一只鹤被惊醒，叫醒了波赫约拉。洛希派来浓雾、海怪和风暴，康特勒琴落进了大海；最后她化作一只巨鹰，带着上百名武士扑向战船。万奈莫宁用船舵打断了她的爪子，三宝跌进海里摔得粉碎：大块沉入海底，成了大海的财富，小块漂到卡勒瓦拉的岸边，带来了丰收；洛希只抢回了三宝的盖子，波赫约拉从此贫穷下去。
summary_en: Väinämöinen, Ilmarinen and Lemminkäinen sail north in a war-boat that longs for battle, to win back the Sampo forged for Pohjola. In the rapids the boat sticks on the back of a giant pike; Väinämöinen kills it and from its jawbone makes the first kantele, whose music draws every creature of earth and sky to listen; he weeps himself, and his tears fall into the sea as blue pearls. In Pohjola Louhi will not share the Sampo, so Väinämöinen plays all the north to sleep; the heroes open the copper mountain, plough out the Sampo's roots with an ox, and carry it off in their boat. Lemminkäinen cannot help singing, a crane wakes and rouses Pohjola, and Louhi sends fog, a sea monster and a storm that sweeps the kantele overboard; at last she becomes a giant eagle carrying a hundred warriors. Väinämöinen smashes her talons with the rudder; the Sampo falls into the sea and shatters: the large pieces become the riches of the sea, the small ones drift to the shores of Kalevala and bring plenty, and Louhi takes home only the lid, so that Pohjola grows poor.

canonical_title: Ares: the war god before Troy (after the Iliad)
title_zh: 阿瑞斯：特洛伊城下的战神（据《伊利亚特》）
summary_zh: 《伊利亚特》里的战神阿瑞斯站在特洛伊人一边，却总是在神的较量中吃亏。雅典娜把他领出战场，阿佛洛狄忒受伤后借他的马车逃回奥林波斯；狄俄涅讲起他曾被巨人兄弟关在铜罐里十三个月。阿波罗召唤他，他化作凡人鼓舞特洛伊人，和赫克托耳并肩冲杀，连狄俄墨得斯也只好后退。赫拉和雅典娜驾车出征，宙斯准许雅典娜去对付他；雅典娜戴上冥王的隐身盔，引导狄俄墨得斯的长矛刺进阿瑞斯的腹部，战神发出九千、一万人一样的吼叫，逃回天上向宙斯诉苦，却被父亲骂作“最可恨的神”。后来他的儿子阿斯卡拉福斯战死，他要下去报仇，又被雅典娜夺下盔甲拦住。最后众神亲自参战，雅典娜用一块界石把他打倒在地，阿佛洛狄忒扶着呻吟的他离开战场。
summary_en: In the Iliad Ares, god of war, fights for the Trojans but keeps losing to other gods. Athena leads him out of the battle; Aphrodite, wounded, borrows his chariot to flee to Olympus; Dione recalls how giant brothers once kept him in a bronze jar for thirteen months. Roused by Apollo, he urges on the Trojans in mortal shape and storms beside Hector until even Diomedes gives way. Hera and Athena drive out, and Zeus lets Athena set upon him: wearing the cap of Hades, she guides Diomedes' spear into Ares' belly, and the war god bellows like nine or ten thousand men, flees to heaven to complain to Zeus, and is called by his father the most hateful of the gods. Later his son Ascalaphus falls, and Athena strips his armour to stop him going down for vengeance. At last, when the gods themselves join battle, Athena fells him with a boundary stone and Aphrodite leads him groaning from the field.

canonical_title: The Argonauts, Part 2: the fleece and the return
title_zh: 阿尔戈英雄 · 下部 金羊毛与归航
summary_zh: 赫拉和雅典娜请阿佛洛狄忒帮忙，小爱神厄洛斯一箭射中了科尔基斯的公主美狄亚，她爱上了伊阿宋。国王埃厄忒斯给伊阿宋出了一道致命的难题：驾驭喷火的铜蹄公牛，耕种战神的田地，种下龙牙，再杀死从地里长出的武士。美狄亚在父亲和异乡人之间痛苦挣扎，最终把魔药交给了伊阿宋。伊阿宋通过了考验，美狄亚又用歌声催眠了看守金羊毛的巨蛇。英雄们带着金羊毛和美狄亚逃走，为了摆脱追兵，伊阿宋设伏杀死了美狄亚的弟弟阿布绪耳托斯。这桩血罪让他们漂泊了更远的路：喀耳刻为他们净罪，海中仙女护送他们穿过漂浮岩，他们在费埃克斯人那里成婚，又被风暴吹到利比亚，扛着船穿越沙漠，美狄亚在克里特用魔眼打倒了铜人塔罗斯，英雄们终于回到了帕伽塞。
summary_en: Hera and Athena ask Aphrodite's help, and Eros shoots Medea, princess of Colchis, so that she falls in love with Jason. King Aeetes sets a deadly trial: yoke fire-breathing bronze-footed bulls, plough the field of Ares, sow a serpent's teeth and slay the armed men who spring from the earth. Torn between her father and the stranger, Medea gives Jason a charm; he passes the trial, and she lulls the serpent guarding the fleece with her song. Fleeing with Medea and the fleece, Jason kills her brother Apsyrtus in an ambush, and the bloodshed drives them far astray: Circe purifies them, sea nymphs guide them past the Wandering Rocks, they marry among the Phaeacians, a storm casts them into Libya where they carry the ship across the desert, and in Crete Medea destroys the bronze giant Talos with her evil eye before they reach Pagasae at last.

canonical_title: The Argonauts, Part 1: the outward voyage
title_zh: 阿尔戈英雄 · 上部 远航
summary_zh: 伊俄尔科斯的国王珀利阿斯得到神谕，要提防穿一只鞋的人，伊阿宋却恰恰在渡河时丢了一只鞋。国王派他去遥远的科尔基斯取回金羊毛。在雅典娜的指点下，人们造好了阿尔戈号，希腊最勇敢的英雄们都来参加：赫拉克勒斯、俄耳甫斯、双子兄弟、北风之子……他们在只有女人的楞诺斯岛停留，在库最科斯的黑夜里误杀了朋友，在密西亚失去了许拉斯和赫拉克勒斯；他们打败了拳王阿密科斯，替盲眼先知菲纽斯赶走了哈耳庇厄，穿过会互相撞击的岩石，最后在夜色中驶进了科尔基斯的法细斯河口。
summary_en: Pelias, king of Iolcus, is warned by an oracle to beware the man with one sandal, and Jason loses a sandal crossing a river. The king sends him to distant Colchis for the golden fleece. With Athena's help the Argo is built, and the bravest heroes of Greece join: Heracles, Orpheus, the twin sons of Zeus, the sons of the North Wind. They linger on Lemnos, an island of women; kill a friend by mistake in the dark at Cyzicus; lose Hylas and Heracles in Mysia; defeat the boxer-king Amycus; free the blind seer Phineus from the Harpies; pass the Clashing Rocks; and at last, by night, sail into the mouth of the Phasis in Colchis.

canonical_title: Artemis: twelve tales of the huntress (after the Library)
title_zh: 阿耳忒弥斯：狩猎女神的十二个故事（据《书库》）
summary_zh: 阿波罗多洛斯的《书库》没有为阿耳忒弥斯写一个连贯的故事，却在许多神话里让她出场。按书中的顺序读下来，就能看到这位女神的全貌：她先于阿波罗出生，还帮母亲接生了弟弟；她和阿波罗一起射死了侵犯勒托的巨人提堤俄斯；她杀死了巨人猎手俄里翁和自以为能攻上天的阿洛伊代兄弟；俄纽斯和阿德墨托斯忘了给她献祭，一个招来了卡吕冬的野猪，一个在婚房里看见满屋的蛇；赫拉克勒斯射伤她的圣鹿，被她当面责备；偷看她沐浴的阿克泰翁被自己的猎狗撕碎；夸耀子女比勒托多的尼俄柏失去了女儿；违背誓言的卡利斯托被变成熊射死；在奥里斯，她用逆风困住希腊舰队，最后从祭坛上带走了伊菲革涅亚。
summary_en: Apollodorus's Library gives Artemis no single connected story, yet she appears in many myths. Read in the book's order they give a full picture of the goddess: born before Apollo, she helps her mother deliver her brother; with Apollo she shoots the giant Tityus who assaulted Leto; she slays the giant hunter Orion and the Aloadae who thought to storm heaven; Oeneus and Admetus forget her sacrifices — one brings down the Calydonian boar, the other finds his bridal chamber full of snakes; Heracles wounds her sacred hind and is rebuked to his face; Actaeon, who saw her bathing, is torn apart by his own hounds; Niobe, who boasted of more children than Leto, loses her daughters; Callisto, who broke her vow, is turned into a bear and shot; and at Aulis she holds the Greek fleet with contrary winds and at last snatches Iphigenia from the altar.

canonical_title: Dionysus: the twice-born god (after the Library)
title_zh: 狄俄倪索斯：两次出生的神（据《书库》）
summary_zh: 宙斯爱上了忒拜公主塞墨勒，赫拉骗塞墨勒请宙斯以向赫拉求婚时的样子来见她。宙斯驾着雷电到来，塞墨勒在恐惧中死去，宙斯从火中救出六个月的胎儿，缝进自己的大腿，到了足月才生下狄俄倪索斯。孩子先由伊诺和阿塔玛斯当作女孩抚养，赫拉让这对夫妇发了疯；宙斯又把他变成小山羊，交给倪萨的仙女们。长大以后，狄俄倪索斯发现了葡萄，被赫拉逼疯，流浪到埃及和叙利亚，在弗里吉亚得到瑞亚的净化，学会了秘仪。色雷斯国王吕枯耳戈斯驱逐了他，最后被马撕碎；忒拜国王彭透斯阻止酒神的狂欢，被自己的母亲撕碎。他雇了第勒尼安海盗的船，海盗想把他卖掉，他让桅杆变成蛇，海盗跳海变成了海豚。最后他从冥府带回母亲，让她以堤俄涅之名升上天空；在阿提卡，伊卡里俄斯从他那里学会了酿酒，却因此丧命。
summary_en: Zeus loved Semele, princess of Thebes, and Hera tricked her into asking Zeus to come to her as he came when he wooed Hera. Zeus came with thunder and lightning; Semele died of fright, and Zeus snatched the six-month child from the fire, sewed it in his thigh and bore Dionysus at full term. The child was reared as a girl by Ino and Athamas, whom Hera drove mad; Zeus turned him into a kid and gave him to the nymphs of Nysa. Grown, Dionysus discovered the vine, was driven mad by Hera, wandered to Egypt and Syria, was purified by Rhea in Phrygia and learned the rites. Lycurgus of Thrace drove him out and was in the end torn apart by horses; Pentheus of Thebes opposed the revels and was torn apart by his own mother. Hiring a Tyrrhenian pirate ship, he turned the mast into snakes when the pirates meant to sell him, and they leapt into the sea and became dolphins. At last he brought his mother up from Hades and ascended with her, renamed Thyone; and in Attica Icarius learned winemaking from him and died for it.

canonical_title: Greek heroes, Part 2: Heracles — birth and the first six labours
title_zh: 希腊英雄 · 第二部 赫拉克勒斯（上）诞生与前六项任务
summary_zh: 赫拉克勒斯出生的那一天，赫拉施计让欧律斯透斯早生，夺走了宙斯许给珀尔修斯后代的王位。还在摇篮里，赫拉克勒斯就掐死了赫拉派来的两条大蛇；少年时，他跟名师学艺，杀死喀泰戎山的狮子，又为忒拜打败了明叶人。赫拉让他发了疯，他亲手杀死了自己的孩子。为了赎罪，德尔斐的神谕命他为欧律斯透斯服役，完成交给他的任务。前六项任务是：扼死刀枪不入的涅墨亚狮子，在侄子伊俄拉俄斯的帮助下杀死九头蛇许德拉，追捕金角牝鹿，活捉厄律曼托斯野猪，一天之内清扫奥革阿斯的牛圈，赶走斯廷法利斯湖的怪鸟。
summary_en: On the day Heracles was to be born, Hera tricked Zeus so that Eurystheus was born first and won the throne Zeus had promised to Perseus's descendant. In his cradle Heracles strangled the two serpents Hera sent; as a youth he learned from famous teachers, killed the lion of Cithaeron and defeated the Minyans for Thebes. Driven mad by Hera, he killed his own children, and the Delphic oracle sent him to serve Eurystheus and perform the labours imposed on him. The first six: strangling the invulnerable Nemean lion, killing the many-headed hydra with his nephew Iolaus, capturing the golden-horned hind, taking the Erymanthian boar alive, cleansing Augeas's cattle-yard in a single day, and driving away the Stymphalian birds.

canonical_title: Greek heroes, Part 4: Heracles — the poisoned robe and the pyre
title_zh: 希腊英雄 · 第四部 赫拉克勒斯（下）毒袍与升天
summary_zh: 十二项任务完成后，赫拉克勒斯在射箭比赛中赢得了伊俄勒，却被她的父亲拒绝；他在疯狂中杀死了伊菲托斯，又在德尔斐与阿波罗争夺三足鼎，最后被卖给吕底亚女王翁法勒为奴三年。服役期满，他攻陷了特洛伊，在巨人之战中与众神并肩作战，又与河神阿刻罗俄斯摔跤赢得了得伊阿尼拉。马人涅索斯在临死前骗得伊阿尼拉保留了他的血。多年后，赫拉克勒斯攻陷俄卡利亚，掳回伊俄勒，得伊阿尼拉害怕失去丈夫的爱，把血涂在长袍上送给他——那血里浸着许德拉的毒。赫拉克勒斯在剧痛中登上俄塔山的火葬堆，一片云把他托上了天空，他与赫拉和解，娶了青春女神赫柏。
summary_en: After the twelve labours Heracles wins Iole in an archery contest but is refused by her father; in madness he kills Iphitus, struggles with Apollo for the Delphic tripod, and is sold for three years as a slave to Omphale, queen of Lydia. Freed, he sacks Troy, fights beside the gods against the giants, and wrestles the river Achelous for Deianira. The dying centaur Nessus tricks Deianira into keeping his blood as a love charm. Years later, when Heracles sacks Oechalia and brings home Iole, Deianira, fearing to lose his love, smears the blood — poisoned by the hydra — on a robe. In agony Heracles mounts a pyre on Mount Oeta; a cloud lifts him to heaven, where he is reconciled with Hera and marries Hebe.

canonical_title: Greek heroes, Part 3: Heracles — the last six labours
title_zh: 希腊英雄 · 第三部 赫拉克勒斯（中）后六项任务
summary_zh: 后六项任务把赫拉克勒斯带到了世界的四方：他从克里特捉回公牛，从色雷斯赶回吃人的牝马，从亚马逊女王那里取得战神的腰带，顺路在特洛伊救下公主赫西俄涅；他乘着太阳神的金杯渡过大洋，杀死三身巨人革律翁，把红色的牛群一路赶回希腊；为了寻找赫斯珀里得斯的金苹果，他和海中老人涅柔斯搏斗，举起大地之子安泰俄斯，射死啄食普罗米修斯肝脏的鹰，又用计让阿特拉斯重新扛起天空；最后，他下到冥府，徒手制服了三头犬刻耳柏洛斯，把它带到人间。
summary_en: The last six labours take Heracles to the four quarters of the world: he brings back the Cretan bull and the man-eating mares of Thrace, wins the belt of Ares from the Amazon queen and rescues Hesione at Troy; he crosses Ocean in the Sun's golden goblet, kills the triple-bodied Geryon and drives his red cattle back to Greece; seeking the golden apples of the Hesperides he wrestles Nereus and lifts Antaeus off the earth, shoots the eagle that devours Prometheus and tricks Atlas into taking back the sky; and at last he goes down to Hades and masters the three-headed Cerberus with his bare hands.

canonical_title: Homeric Hymns, Part 4: Aphrodite — the goddess and the herdsman
title_zh: 荷马颂歌 · 第四部 致阿佛洛狄忒：女神与牧人
summary_zh: 阿佛洛狄忒能让众神、凡人和一切鸟兽产生爱欲，只有三位女神的心她无法改变：爱战争和手艺的雅典娜、爱弓箭和山林的阿耳忒弥斯，以及发誓永远做处女、在每户人家的正中享受尊荣的赫斯提亚。阿佛洛狄忒常常让宙斯爱上凡间女子，宙斯便反过来让她爱上在伊达山放牛的特洛伊王子安喀塞斯。她在帕福斯梳妆以后来到伊达山，扮成弗里吉亚的公主走进他的小屋。醒来以后她现出真身，告诉吓坏了的安喀塞斯，他们会有一个儿子叫埃涅阿斯；她讲了宙斯带走伽倪墨得斯，讲了黎明女神厄俄斯为情人提托诺斯求得了不死却忘了求不老，最后托山中的仙女抚养孩子，并警告他永远不要说出孩子的母亲是谁。
summary_en: Aphrodite stirs desire in gods, men and all creatures; only three goddesses she cannot bend — Athena who loves war and handicraft, Artemis who loves the bow and the mountains, and Hestia, sworn to maidenhood and honoured at the centre of every house. Because Aphrodite often made Zeus love mortal women, Zeus in turn made her love Anchises, a Trojan prince herding cattle on Ida. Adorned at Paphos, she came to Ida and entered his hut disguised as a Phrygian princess. Afterwards she revealed herself to the terrified Anchises and told him they would have a son, Aeneas; she told how Zeus carried off Ganymede, and how Eos won immortality for her beloved Tithonus but forgot to ask for youth; then she entrusted the child to the mountain nymphs and warned Anchises never to say who his mother was.

canonical_title: Homeric Hymns, Part 2: Apollo — Leto's wandering and Delphi
title_zh: 荷马颂歌 · 第二部 致阿波罗：勒托的漂泊与德尔斐
summary_zh: 勒托怀着宙斯的孩子，走遍了爱琴海四周的土地，却没有一处敢接纳她，因为人人都怕那个将要出生的神。只有贫瘠多石的得洛斯岛，在勒托发誓之后答应了她。赫拉把生育女神厄勒梯亚留在奥林波斯，勒托在岛上阵痛了九天九夜，直到众女神派伊里斯用一条金项链把厄勒梯亚请来。勒托抱住一棵棕榈树，生下了阿波罗；阿波罗一尝到神食就挣开襁褓，说竖琴和弯弓是他的心爱之物。后半首讲阿波罗寻找建立神谕所的地方：他被泉水女神泰尔福萨骗到帕尔纳索斯山下的克里萨，在那里奠下神庙的地基，射死了替赫拉抚养提丰的母龙，又化身海豚把一船克里特人带来做他的祭司。
summary_en: Leto, carrying Zeus's child, wanders all the lands around the Aegean, but none dares to receive her, for all fear the god to be born. Only rocky Delos agrees, once Leto has sworn an oath. Hera keeps Eileithyia, goddess of birth, on Olympus, and Leto labours nine days and nights until the goddesses send Iris with a golden necklace to bring her. Clasping a palm tree, Leto bears Apollo, who at his first taste of ambrosia bursts his swaddling bands and claims the lyre and the curved bow. The second half tells how Apollo seeks a site for his oracle: tricked by the spring nymph Telphusa into going to Crisa below Parnassus, he lays the foundations of his temple, shoots the she-dragon that had reared Typhaon for Hera, and in the form of a dolphin brings a shipload of Cretans to be his priests.

canonical_title: Homeric Hymns, Part 3: Hermes — Maia's child
title_zh: 荷马颂歌 · 第三部 致赫尔墨斯：迈亚的孩子
summary_zh: 仙女迈亚住在库勒涅山的幽暗山洞里，宙斯趁赫拉熟睡时夜里去找她，她生下了赫尔墨斯。这个孩子清晨出生，中午就用一只乌龟的壳做成了竖琴，傍晚就偷走了阿波罗的五十头牛：他让牛倒着走，自己穿上树枝编的鞋，在阿尔甫斯河边生火宰了两头牛，再像一阵雾一样从锁孔钻回摇篮。迈亚责备他，他却说要做盗贼的首领。阿波罗循着古怪的蹄印找到山洞，赫尔墨斯装成刚出生的婴儿，矢口否认；两兄弟一直吵到宙斯面前，宙斯哈哈大笑，命他们和好。最后赫尔墨斯弹起竖琴，阿波罗听得入迷，便用牛群换下了竖琴，两位神从此结为朋友。
summary_en: The nymph Maia lived in a shadowy cave on Mount Cyllene; Zeus came to her by night while Hera slept, and she bore Hermes. Born at dawn, by midday he had made a lyre from a tortoise shell, and by evening he had stolen fifty of Apollo's cattle, driving them backwards while he wore sandals woven of twigs; by the Alpheus he made fire and slaughtered two cows, then slipped back through the keyhole like mist into his cradle. Maia scolded him, and he answered that he would be prince of thieves. Apollo followed the strange tracks to the cave; Hermes curled up like a newborn and denied everything, and the brothers took their quarrel to Zeus, who laughed and bade them make peace. At last Hermes played the lyre, Apollo was enchanted, and traded the cattle for it; the two gods became friends for ever.

canonical_title: The Odyssey, Part 2: the homecoming
title_zh: 奥德赛 · 下部 归家
summary_zh: 费埃克斯人把熟睡的奥德修斯送回伊塔卡。雅典娜把他变成一个衰老的乞丐，他先投宿在忠心的牧猪人欧迈俄斯的茅屋里，又和从斯巴达回来的儿子忒勒马科斯相认。他以乞丐的身份走进自己的宫殿，老狗阿尔戈斯认出了他的声音，求婚人却百般羞辱他。老奶妈从伤疤上认出了他，珀涅罗珀宣布用奥德修斯的弓举行比赛。没有一个求婚人能拉开那张弓，乞丐却轻轻上了弦，一箭射穿十二把斧头，然后在大厅里向求婚人复仇。珀涅罗珀用他们婚床的秘密试探了他，夫妻终于团圆；他又在果园里与年迈的父亲相认，最后雅典娜让伊塔卡恢复了和平。
summary_en: The Phaeacians carry the sleeping Odysseus home to Ithaca. Athena disguises him as an old beggar; he lodges with his loyal swineherd Eumaeus and is reunited with his son Telemachus, back from Sparta. As a beggar he enters his own palace, where the old dog Argos knows his voice and the suitors abuse him. His old nurse recognises his scar, and Penelope announces a contest with Odysseus's bow. No suitor can string it; the beggar strings it easily, shoots through twelve axes and takes his revenge in the hall. Penelope tests him with the secret of their bed and husband and wife are reunited; he makes himself known to his aged father in the orchard, and Athena at last brings peace to Ithaca.

canonical_title: The Odyssey, Part 1: the wanderings
title_zh: 奥德赛 · 上部 漂泊
summary_zh: 特洛伊陷落十年后，奥德修斯仍被女神卡吕普索留在海岛上，家中的求婚人占据他的宫殿，逼他的妻子珀涅罗珀改嫁。雅典娜说动众神，又鼓励他的儿子忒勒马科斯出海寻父。赫尔墨斯传达宙斯的命令，奥德修斯乘木筏离开，被波塞冬的风暴打翻，漂到费埃克斯人的海岸，被公主瑙西卡救起。在国王的宴会上，他讲述了自己的漂泊：食莲者之地、独眼巨人波吕斐摩斯的山洞、风神的风袋、吃人的巨人、把人变成猪的喀耳刻、冥府中先知的预言、塞壬的歌声、斯库拉与卡律布狄斯，以及同伴们因为宰吃太阳神的牛而全部葬身大海。
summary_en: Ten years after Troy, Odysseus is still held by the goddess Calypso while suitors occupy his palace and press his wife Penelope to remarry. Athena persuades the gods and rouses his son Telemachus to sail for news. Hermes brings Zeus's command, Odysseus leaves on a raft, is wrecked by Poseidon's storm and washes up among the Phaeacians, rescued by the princess Nausicaa. At the king's feast he tells of his wanderings: the Lotus-eaters, the cave of the Cyclops Polyphemus, the bag of winds, the man-eating Laestrygonians, Circe who turns men into swine, the prophecy of Tiresias in the land of the dead, the Sirens' song, Scylla and Charybdis, and how his last companions perished for eating the cattle of the Sun.

canonical_title: Greek heroes, Part 1: Perseus
title_zh: 希腊英雄 · 第一部 珀尔修斯
summary_zh: 阿尔戈斯国王阿克里西俄斯得到神谕：女儿达那厄的儿子会杀死他。他把达那厄关进地下的铜屋，宙斯却化作金雨与她相会，生下珀尔修斯。母子被装进木箱抛进大海，漂到塞里福斯岛。国王波吕得克忒斯想霸占达那厄，设计让珀尔修斯去取戈耳工的头。珀尔修斯在雅典娜和赫尔墨斯的指引下，夺走格赖埃三姐妹共用的眼睛，从仙女那里得到飞鞋、口袋和隐身帽，在熟睡中割下美杜莎的头；归途中他救下被献给海怪的公主安德洛墨达，把阴谋者变成石头，最后在一场竞技会上用铁饼误杀了外祖父，应验了神谕。
summary_en: Acrisius, king of Argos, is told that his daughter Danaë's son will kill him. He shuts her in an underground bronze chamber, but Zeus comes to her as a shower of gold and she bears Perseus. Mother and child are cast into the sea in a chest and wash up on Seriphos. King Polydectes, who wants Danaë, tricks Perseus into promising the Gorgon's head. Guided by Athena and Hermes, Perseus seizes the single eye of the grey sisters, receives winged sandals, a wallet and the cap of Hades from the nymphs, and cuts off Medusa's head as she sleeps. On his way home he rescues the princess Andromeda from a sea monster, turns plotters to stone, and at funeral games accidentally kills his grandfather with a discus, fulfilling the oracle.

canonical_title: The Theogony: from Chaos to the reign of Zeus
title_zh: 神谱：从混沌到宙斯为王
summary_zh: 赫西俄德在赫利孔山下牧羊时，缪斯赐给他诗歌。他从头讲起：最先出现的是卡俄斯，接着是大地盖亚和爱若斯；天空乌拉诺斯把孩子们压在大地之下，克洛诺斯用一把镰刀推翻了父亲，阿佛洛狄忒从浪花中诞生；克洛诺斯吞下自己的孩子，瑞亚用一块石头救下宙斯；普罗米修斯为人类盗火；宙斯放出百臂巨人，打赢十年的泰坦之战，又击败提丰，最终被众神推举为王。
summary_en: Hesiod, tending sheep below Helicon, receives song from the Muses and tells the story from the beginning: first Chaos, then Earth and Eros; Ouranos buries his children inside Earth until Cronus overthrows him with a sickle and Aphrodite rises from the foam; Cronus swallows his children until Rhea saves Zeus with a stone; Prometheus steals fire; Zeus frees the Hundred-Handers, wins the ten-year war against the Titans, defeats Typhoeus, and is chosen king of the gods.

canonical_title: The children of the Titans: light, wind, sleep and death (after Hesiod's Theogony)
title_zh: 提坦的子女：光、风、睡与死（据赫西俄德《神谱》）
summary_zh: 赫西俄德的《神谱》除了讲宙斯怎样夺得王位，还记下了许多很少被单独讲述的神的家世。混沌生出幽暗厄瑞玻斯和黑夜，黑夜又生出明亮的埃忒耳和白昼赫墨拉；大地和天空生下十二位提坦，其中有克利俄斯、许珀里翁和忒亚；黑夜独自生下睡神许普诺斯和死神塔纳托斯。忒亚为许珀里翁生下太阳、月亮塞勒涅和黎明厄俄斯，海的女儿欧律比亚为克利俄斯生下阿斯特赖俄斯、帕拉斯和珀耳塞斯；厄俄斯和阿斯特赖俄斯生下了风和星辰，帕拉斯和斯梯克斯生下了胜利与力量，斯梯克斯因为第一个投奔宙斯而成了众神的誓言。福柏的女儿阿斯忒里亚嫁给珀耳塞斯，生下了受宙斯尊崇的赫卡忒。诗的后半还写到夜与昼在铜门槛前交替、睡与死住在大地边缘的屋子里，以及厄俄斯为提托诺斯生下的儿子们。
summary_en: Besides telling how Zeus won his throne, Hesiod's Theogony records the families of many gods seldom told on their own. Chaos brings forth Erebus and Night; Night bears bright Aether and Day; Earth and Heaven bear the twelve Titans, among them Crius, Hyperion and Theia; Night alone bears Sleep and Death. Theia bears Sun, Moon and Dawn to Hyperion; Eurybia, daughter of Sea, bears Astraeus, Pallas and Perses to Crius; Dawn and Astraeus bring forth the winds and stars; Pallas and Styx bring forth Victory and Strength, and Styx, first to come to Zeus's side, becomes the oath of the gods. Phoebe's daughter Asteria marries Perses and bears Hecate, whom Zeus honours above all. Later the poem shows Night and Day passing at a bronze threshold, Sleep and Death dwelling at the edge of the world, and the sons Dawn bore to Tithonus.

canonical_title: Pele's journey to Halemaʻumaʻu
title_zh: 佩蕾的旅程：从卡希基到哈雷茂茂
summary_zh: 美国国家公园管理局概述夏威夷口述传统：火山女神佩蕾生在遥远的卡希基，为寻找适合她的火与家人的居所，远航来到夏威夷群岛，一路向东南迁移，最后在基拉韦厄山顶的哈雷茂茂火山口安家，据说至今仍住在那里。按照夏威夷传统，经过她的土地要先请求许可。

In Hawaiian tradition one asks her permission to travel through her land.

canonical_title: Mahābhārata, Part 3: the field of the Kurus
title_zh: 摩诃婆罗多 · 第三部 俱卢之野
summary_zh: 十三年的流放结束后，般度五子要求归还王国，黑天亲自到象城斡旋，难敌却连针尖大的土地都不肯让出，大战不可避免。两军在俱卢之野对阵，阿周那看见对面都是亲人和老师，放下了弓，黑天在战车上为他讲述了《薄伽梵歌》。第十天，毗湿摩在束发的掩护下被阿周那的箭射倒，躺在箭床上等待自己选定的死期。第十三天，阿周那年轻的儿子激昂冲进轮阵，被众将围杀；阿周那发誓日落前杀死胜车，在黑天的帮助下做到了。夜战中，迦尔纳用因陀罗的神矛杀死了怖军的儿子瓶首。坚战说出“马嘶死了”的半句真话，德罗纳放下武器被杀。迦尔纳的车轮陷进泥里，被阿周那射杀。最后一天，难敌藏进湖底，被逼出来与怖军杵战，怖军击碎了他的大腿。当夜，马嘶偷袭熟睡的营地，杀死了黑公主的五个儿子和许多将领。十八天之后，十八支大军只剩下寥寥数人。
summary_en: When the thirteen years of exile end, the Pāṇḍavas ask for their kingdom back; Kṛṣṇa goes himself to Hastināpura as envoy, but Duryodhana will not yield even as much land as a needle's point, and war is certain. The armies face each other at Kurukṣetra; seeing kinsmen and teachers opposite, Arjuna lays down his bow, and Kṛṣṇa, on the chariot, teaches him the Bhagavad Gītā. On the tenth day Bhīṣma falls to Arjuna's arrows behind Śikhaṇḍin and lies on a bed of arrows awaiting the death he has chosen. On the thirteenth, Arjuna's young son Abhimanyu breaks into the circular array and is cut down by many; Arjuna vows to kill Jayadratha before sunset and, with Kṛṣṇa's help, does. In a night battle Karṇa spends Indra's dart on Bhīma's son Ghaṭotkaca. Yudhiṣṭhira's half-truth 'Aśvatthāman is dead' makes Droṇa lay down his arms and die. Karṇa's chariot wheel sinks and Arjuna shoots him. On the last day Duryodhana hides under a lake, is drawn out to fight Bhīma with maces, and his thighs are shattered. That night Aśvatthāman raids the sleeping camp, killing Draupadī's five sons and many chiefs. After eighteen days, of eighteen armies only a handful remain.

canonical_title: Mahābhārata, Part 1: Nala and Damayantī
title_zh: 摩诃婆罗多 · 第一部 那罗与达摩衍蒂
summary_zh: 般度五子在掷骰中失去王国、流放森林，坚战悲叹世上没有比他更不幸的国王，仙人巨马就给他讲了那罗的故事。尼沙陀国王那罗与毗陀婆公主达摩衍蒂经天鹅传情而相爱。选婿大会上，因陀罗、阿耆尼、伐楼那和阎摩四位天神都化作那罗的模样，达摩衍蒂凭着天神不流汗、不眨眼、脚不沾地的特征认出了真正的那罗。迦利因此怀恨，等了十二年，趁那罗一次疏忽进入他的身体，让他在骰子上把王国输给了弟弟补湿迦罗。那罗与妻子流落森林，在半夜割下她的一半衣裳，丢下她独自离去。达摩衍蒂历经蟒蛇、猎人、商队和象群的灾难，到了车底国；那罗则从林火中救出蛇王迦尔郭吒迦，被它咬后变了模样，化名巴胡迦，做了阿逾陀王利图帕尔纳的车夫。达摩衍蒂宣布第二次选婿，利图帕尔纳乘巴胡迦驾的车一日飞驰百由旬，途中把骰子的学问教给了他，迦利从那罗身上离去。夫妻终于相认，那罗赢回了王国，宽恕了弟弟。
summary_en: When the Pāṇḍavas have lost their kingdom at dice and gone into exile, Yudhiṣṭhira laments that no king was ever so unfortunate, and the sage Bṛhadaśva tells him the story of Nala. Nala, king of the Nishadhas, and Damayantī, princess of Vidarbha, fall in love through a swan's messages. At her svayaṃvara the gods Indra, Agni, Varuṇa and Yama all take Nala's form, but Damayantī knows the real Nala because the gods do not sweat or blink and their feet do not touch the ground. Kali resents it, waits twelve years for a lapse and enters Nala, who loses his kingdom at dice to his brother Pushkara. Exiled in the forest, Nala cuts away half of his sleeping wife's garment at midnight and leaves her. Damayantī survives a python, a hunter, a stampede of elephants and reaches the Chedi kingdom; Nala rescues the nāga Karkoṭaka from a forest fire, is bitten and changed, and becomes Bāhuka, charioteer to King Ṛtuparṇa of Ayodhyā. Damayantī announces a second svayaṃvara; Ṛtuparṇa races there with Bāhuka, teaching him the science of dice on the way, and Kali leaves Nala. Husband and wife know each other again, and Nala wins back his kingdom and forgives his brother.

canonical_title: The Rāmāyaṇa: the long story of Rāma and Sītā
title_zh: 罗摩衍那：罗摩与悉多的长篇故事
summary_zh: 阿逾陀的十车王求子，毗湿奴为了消灭不怕天神与恶魔的罗刹王罗波那，化身为王子罗摩降生。罗摩折断湿婆的大弓，娶了从犁沟里出生的悉多；却因继母吉迦伊的两个恩典被流放森林十四年，悉多和弟弟罗什曼那随行，弟弟婆罗多把罗摩的鞋子供在王座上代为摄政。在森林里，罗波那用金鹿引开罗摩，劫走悉多。罗摩与猴王须羯哩婆结盟，神猴哈奴曼一跃跨过大海，在无忧树林里找到悉多，火烧楞伽。猴军在海上架起石桥，罗摩在大战中射杀罗波那。悉多经过火的考验，众人乘飞车回到阿逾陀，罗摩加冕为王。
summary_en: King Daśaratha of Ayodhyā prays for sons, and Vishnu is born as Prince Rāma to destroy Rāvaṇa, the rākṣasa king whom no god or demon can kill. Rāma breaks Śiva's bow and marries Sītā, born from a furrow, but is exiled to the forest for fourteen years through his stepmother Kaikeyī's two boons, followed by Sītā and Lakṣmaṇa, while Bharata rules in the name of his sandals. Rāvaṇa lures Rāma away with a golden deer and carries Sītā off. Rāma allies with the vānara king Sugrīva; Hanumān leaps the sea, finds Sītā in the aśoka grove and burns Laṅkā. The army builds a bridge across the sea, Rāma kills Rāvaṇa, Sītā passes through fire and Rāma is crowned in Ayodhyā.

canonical_title: The Rāmāyaṇa, Part 3: the Book of the Forest
title_zh: 罗摩衍那 · 第三部 森林篇
summary_zh: 罗摩三人走进弹宅迦林，答应保护受罗刹侵扰的仙人；悉多劝罗摩不要无故杀生，罗摩说保护苦行者是刹帝利的职责。十年后他们在五树林安家，结识了鹫王阇吒优私。罗波那的妹妹首哩薄那迦向罗摩求爱不成，扑向悉多，被罗什曼那割去鼻耳，罗摩独自消灭了伽罗的一万四千罗刹。罗波那受到激将，逼迫摩哩遮变成金鹿引开罗摩；悉多听见假的呼救声，用刺耳的话逼走了罗什曼那。罗波那扮作苦行者劫走悉多，阇吒优私拼死阻拦，被砍断双翼。罗摩回来发现草屋已空，悲痛欲狂，安葬了阇吒优私，又在迦槃陀的指点和舍波哩的款待下，走向般波湖。
summary_en: Entering the Daṇḍaka forest, Rāma promises to protect the hermits from rākṣasas; Sītā warns him against needless violence, and he answers that protecting ascetics is a warrior's duty. After ten years they settle at Pañcavaṭī, befriended by the vulture-king Jaṭāyu. Rāvaṇa's sister Śūrpaṇakhā, rebuffed by both brothers, attacks Sītā and loses her nose and ears; Rāma alone destroys Khara's fourteen thousand. Goaded, Rāvaṇa forces Mārīca to become a golden deer; Sītā, hearing a false cry for help, drives Lakṣmaṇa away with cruel words. Rāvaṇa, disguised as an ascetic, carries her off, cutting down Jaṭāyu. Rāma returns to an empty hut, mourns, cremates Jaṭāyu and, guided by Kabandha and welcomed by Śabarī, sets out for Lake Pampā.

canonical_title: The Rāmāyaṇa, Part 2: the Book of Ayodhyā
title_zh: 罗摩衍那 · 第二部 阿逾陀篇
summary_zh: 十车王要立罗摩为太子，全城欢庆；驼背侍女曼他罗却说动王后吉迦伊，用两个旧恩典要求立婆罗多为太子、流放罗摩十四年。国王哀求了一整夜，罗摩却面不改色地接受了。悉多说出一番感人的话坚持同行，罗什曼那也追随兄长，三人穿上树皮衣离开阿逾陀，在猎人首领古诃的帮助下渡过恒河，住进质多罗俱吒山。十车王想起年轻时误杀苦行少年所受的诅咒，在悲痛中死去。婆罗多回国后痛斥母亲，拒绝王位，带着大军进山请兄长回去；罗摩坚守父亲的诺言，婆罗多只得带回兄长的鞋子供在王座上，自己在南迪村以鞋子的名义摄政。
summary_en: Daśaratha resolves to consecrate Rāma as heir, and the city rejoices; but the hunchbacked maid Mantharā persuades Queen Kaikeyī to claim two old boons: Bharata's consecration and Rāma's exile for fourteen years. The king pleads all night; Rāma accepts without a change of face. Sītā insists with moving words on going too, Lakṣmaṇa follows his brother, and the three leave Ayodhyā in bark garments, cross the Ganges with the help of the hunter-king Guha and settle on Mount Citrakūṭa. Daśaratha dies of grief, remembering a curse laid on him for killing a young ascetic. Bharata returns, rebukes his mother, refuses the throne and leads an army to bring Rāma back; Rāma keeps his father's word, and Bharata carries home his brother's sandals to rule in their name from Nandigrāma.

canonical_title: The Rāmāyaṇa, Part 1: the Book of Childhood
title_zh: 罗摩衍那 · 第一部 童年篇
summary_zh: 诗人蚁垤因一对麻鹬的悲剧而创出诗体，梵天命他唱出罗摩的故事。阿逾陀的十车王无子，请来从未见过女人的鹿角仙人主持祭祀；众神请毗湿奴下凡除掉罗波那，罗摩与三个弟弟诞生。少年罗摩随众友仙人入林，射杀女罗刹多吒迦，得到神兵，又沿途听仙人讲述恒河如何从天而降、众友仙人自己如何由国王修成梵仙。他踏进乔达摩的净修林，解除了阿诃厘耶的诅咒，在弥提罗折断湿婆大弓，娶了悉多。归途上，持斧罗摩拦路挑战，罗摩拉开毗湿奴之弓，持斧罗摩退去。
summary_en: The poet Vālmīki turns grief at a curlew's death into verse, and Brahmā commands him to sing of Rāma. Childless King Daśaratha brings the forest-bred sage Ṛṣyaśṛṅga to lead his sacrifice; the gods ask Vishnu to be born to destroy Rāvaṇa, and Rāma and his three brothers are born. The boy Rāma follows Viśvāmitra into the forest, kills the rākṣasī Tāṭakā, receives the divine weapons and hears on the road how the Ganges came down from heaven and how Viśvāmitra rose from king to brahmin sage. He frees Ahalyā from her curse, breaks Śiva's bow at Mithilā and marries Sītā, and on the way home Paraśurāma yields when Rāma strings the bow of Vishnu.

canonical_title: The Rāmāyaṇa, Part 4: the Book of Kiṣkindhā
title_zh: 罗摩衍那 · 第四部 猴国篇
summary_zh: 春天的般波湖边，罗摩思念悉多，悲伤难抑。须羯哩婆派哈奴曼扮作苦行者来打探，罗摩与猴王在火前结为盟友，认出了悉多扔下的首饰。须羯哩婆讲述了哥哥波林如何夺走他的妻子和王国；罗摩一脚踢飞杜度毗的骸骨、一箭射穿七棵娑罗树，让他相信自己的力量。第二次兄弟决斗时，须羯哩婆戴上花环，罗摩从树后一箭射倒波林，垂死的波林责问罗摩，罗摩作出回答，多罗哀哭不已。须羯哩婆登上王位，雨季过后却沉湎享乐，罗什曼那怒闯猴城。猴军终于分赴四方，罗摩把戒指交给哈奴曼。南路猴军迷失在山洞里，几乎绝望，直到遇见阇吒优私的哥哥商波底，得知悉多在海那边的楞伽；老熊阇婆梵唤醒了哈奴曼身上的力量。
summary_en: In spring by Lake Pampā Rāma is overcome with longing for Sītā. Sugrīva sends Hanumān, disguised as an ascetic, to find out who the brothers are; Rāma and the monkey-king swear friendship before a fire, and Rāma recognises the ornaments Sītā dropped. Sugrīva tells how his brother Vālin took his wife and kingdom; Rāma kicks away the giant Dundubhi's bones and shoots through seven sāl trees to prove his strength. At the second duel Sugrīva wears a garland, and Rāma shoots Vālin from behind a tree; the dying Vālin reproaches him, Rāma answers, and Tārā laments. Crowned, Sugrīva forgets his promise through the rains until Lakṣmaṇa storms into Kiṣkindhā. The armies go out to the four quarters, Rāma gives his ring to Hanumān, and the southern party, lost and despairing, learns from Jaṭāyu's brother Sampāti that Sītā is in Laṅkā across the sea; the old bear Jāmbavān awakens Hanumān's strength.

canonical_title: The Rāmāyaṇa, Part 5: the Beautiful Book
title_zh: 罗摩衍那 · 第五部 美妙篇
summary_zh: 哈奴曼从摩亨陀罗山一跃而起，越过弥那迦山、通过蛇母须罗娑的考验、撕开女妖辛悉迦，落在楞伽的三峰山上。他缩小身体潜入城中，打倒楞伽城的守护女神，在月光下搜遍罗波那的宫殿，最后在无忧树林里找到了被女罗刹围着的悉多。他亲眼看见罗波那威胁悉多、悉多隔着一根草斥责他，又听见老女罗刹特哩阇吒讲述预示罗摩胜利的梦。他在树上轻轻唱起罗摩的故事，递上戒指，悉多把髻珠交给他，又讲了只有她和罗摩知道的乌鸦的故事。哈奴曼毁掉树林、杀死王子阿刹，被因陀罗耆用梵天神兵擒住，在罗波那殿前直言相劝，尾巴被点燃后反而火烧楞伽，最后跃回大海对岸，在蜜林里和猴子们欢庆，向罗摩报告：我见到悉多了！
summary_en: Hanumān leaps from Mount Mahendra, rests on no mountain, passes Surasā's test, tears Siṃhikā apart and lands on Mount Trikūṭa. Shrunk to a cat's size, he overcomes Laṅkā's guardian goddess, searches Rāvaṇa's palaces by moonlight and at last finds Sītā in the aśoka grove among rākṣasīs. He watches Rāvaṇa threaten her and Sītā answer across a blade of grass, hears the old rākṣasī Trijaṭā's dream of Rāma's victory, sings Rāma's story softly from the tree, gives the ring and receives her crest-jewel and the secret tale of the crow. He wrecks the grove, kills Prince Akṣa, is bound by Indrajit's weapon of Brahmā, counsels Rāvaṇa to his face, and when his tail is set alight burns Laṅkā, then leaps home to tell Rāma: 'I have seen Sītā.'

canonical_title: The Rāmāyaṇa, Part 6: the Book of War
title_zh: 罗摩衍那 · 第六部 战斗篇
summary_zh: 猴熊大军进军南海。楞伽城里，维毗沙那劝罗波那归还悉多，反遭辱骂，于是投奔罗摩，罗摩接纳了他。大海指点那罗造桥，五天之内一座石桥横跨大海。罗波那用幻术拿出假头颅欺骗悉多，又拒绝了安伽陀带去的最后通牒。因陀罗耆用蛇箭捆住罗摩兄弟，金翅鸟飞来解救；巨人鸠槃羯叻拿被唤醒，在战场上吞食猴兵，被罗摩射杀。因陀罗耆又用梵天神兵击倒全军，哈奴曼搬来整座药山救活众人；因陀罗耆用幻影悉多扰乱军心，最终在尼昆毗拉祭坛前被罗什曼那射死。罗波那亲自出战，用神矛击倒罗什曼那，哈奴曼再取药草。罗摩登上因陀罗的天车，用梵天之箭射穿罗波那的心脏。维毗沙那登上楞伽王位。悉多走进火中证明清白，火神把她交还罗摩，众人乘飞车回到阿逾陀，罗摩加冕为王。
summary_en: The army of monkeys and bears marches to the southern sea. In Laṅkā Vibhīṣaṇa urges Rāvaṇa to return Sītā, is insulted and takes refuge with Rāma, who receives him. The Ocean tells Nala how to build a bridge, finished in five days. Rāvaṇa deceives Sītā with a false head of Rāma and rejects Aṅgada's ultimatum. Indrajit binds the brothers with serpent arrows until Garuḍa frees them; the giant Kumbhakarṇa is woken, devours monkeys and is slain by Rāma. Indrajit fells the army with the weapon of Brahmā and Hanumān brings a whole mountain of herbs; Indrajit kills an illusory Sītā to break their spirit and is slain by Lakṣmaṇa at the Nikumbhilā shrine. Rāvaṇa strikes Lakṣmaṇa down with a dart and Hanumān fetches herbs again. In Indra's chariot Rāma pierces Rāvaṇa's heart with the weapon of Brahmā. Vibhīṣaṇa is crowned; Sītā enters the fire and Agni returns her; they fly home to Ayodhyā, and Rāma is crowned.

canonical_title: Churning of the Ocean — Mahābhārata critical edition and Bhāgavata Purāṇa witnesses
title_zh: 乳海搅拌：《摩诃婆罗多》精校本与《薄伽梵往世书》
summary_zh: 两份梵语见证都以曼陀罗山为搅棒、婆苏吉为搅绳，并让檀文陀利捧着甘露出现、罗睺被神盘斩首；但托山的龟在精校本中是龟王阿库帕拉，在《薄伽梵往世书》中是毗湿奴的龟形化身，湿婆饮毒也只见于后者的当前定位。吴哥寺浮雕继续作为独立的物质见证。
summary_en: Both Sanskrit witnesses use Mount Mandara as the rod and Vāsuki as the rope, have Dhanvantari emerge with the amṛta and Rāhu beheaded by the discus; but the tortoise supporting the mountain is the tortoise king Akūpāra in the critical edition and Viṣṇu's tortoise form in the Bhāgavata Purāṇa, and Śiva drinking the poison appears only at the latter's locator. The Angkor Wat relief remains a separate material witness.

canonical_title: Mahābhārata, Part 2: Sāvitrī
title_zh: 摩诃婆罗多 · 第二部 莎维德丽
summary_zh: 坚战问仙人摩根德耶，世上可有像黑公主那样贤德的女子，仙人就讲了莎维德丽的故事。摩德罗国王马主王没有子女，供奉了十八年，女神莎维德丽从祭火中现身，赐给他一个女儿，取名莎维德丽。公主长大后美丽而光彩照人，竟没有人敢来求婚，父亲就让她自己出门去选夫婿。她选中了被逐的盲王迪尤摩特舍那之子萨谛梵，仙人那罗陀却说：萨谛梵一年之后就会死去。莎维德丽说：我已经选定了，绝不改变。她嫁到林中，换上树皮衣，侍奉公婆，默默数着日子。最后三天她不吃不喝地斋戒，最后一天跟着丈夫进林砍柴。萨谛梵头痛倒在她的膝上，死神阎摩亲自拿着绳索来取他的灵魂。莎维德丽一路跟在阎摩身后，用关于正法与友谊的言语打动了死神，阎摩一连赐给她恩惠，最后不得不把萨谛梵的生命还给她。夫妻在夜色中回到净修林，迪尤摩特舍那重见光明，又恢复了王国。
summary_en: Yudhiṣṭhira asks the sage Mārkaṇḍeya whether there was ever a woman as virtuous as Draupadī, and the sage tells of Sāvitrī. King Aśvapati of Madra, childless, makes offerings for eighteen years until the goddess Sāvitrī rises from the sacrificial fire and grants him a daughter, named Sāvitrī. Grown radiant and beautiful, she has no suitors, for none dares ask, so her father sends her to choose a husband herself. She chooses Satyavān, son of the blind, exiled King Dyumatsena — but the sage Nārada says Satyavān will die in a year. 'I have chosen once; I will not choose again,' says Sāvitrī. She marries into the forest, wears bark garments, serves his parents and silently counts the days. For the last three days she fasts, and on the last she goes with her husband to cut wood. Satyavān falls with a headache into her lap, and Yama, god of death, comes himself with his noose for his soul. Sāvitrī follows Yama, moving him with words of dharma and friendship; he grants boon after boon, and at last must give Satyavān's life back. Husband and wife return through the night to the hermitage, where Dyumatsena regains his sight and then his kingdom.

canonical_title: The Second Battle of Mag Tuired
title_zh: 第二次马格图雷德之战：达格达、莫莉甘、布里格与鲁格
summary_zh: 中世纪爱尔兰传说《第二次马格图雷德之战》：达格达拥有“没有人吃不饱”的大锅；“百艺之主”鲁格来到塔拉；萨温节时达格达在河边遇见莫莉甘；布里格为战死的儿子哀哭，是爱尔兰第一次听到哀歌；鲁格用投石击毁巴洛尔的毒眼；战后莫莉甘向全爱尔兰宣告胜利。
summary_en: The medieval Irish saga Cath Maige Tuired: the Dagda's cauldron leaves no one unsatisfied; Lug, master of all arts, comes to Tara; at Samain the Dagda meets the Morrígan by the river; Bríg keens for her slain son, the first keening in Ireland; Lug's sling stone drives Balor's deadly eye through his head; and the Morrígan proclaims the victory across Ireland.

canonical_title: The Cattle Raid of Cooley, Part 2: Fer Diad and the battle of the bulls
title_zh: 夺牛长征记 · 下部 费迪亚德与公牛之战
summary_zh: 梅芙用女儿、财宝和诗人的讽刺逼迫库丘林的结拜兄弟费迪亚德出战。两个曾在斯卡塔赫门下一同学艺的朋友在浅滩上苦战四天，白天拼杀，夜里互赠草药和食物；第四天，库丘林用可怕的迦耶·博尔加杀死了费迪亚德，抱着他的尸体痛哭。库丘林的父亲苏阿尔塔姆到艾温·马哈呼喊求援，阿尔斯特人终于从衰弱中醒来。在加雷赫的大战中，弗格斯遵守诺言在库丘林面前退让，四省大军溃散，库丘林饶了梅芙的性命。可是褐色公牛已经被带到了康诺特，它与白角公牛在一整夜里跑遍了爱尔兰，把对手撕成碎片，最后回到故乡，心碎而死。
summary_en: With her daughter, her treasures and the threat of poets' satire, Medb forces Cú Chulainn's foster-brother Fer Diad to fight him. The two friends who learned arms together under Scáthach fight four days at the ford, sending each other herbs and food each night; on the fourth day Cú Chulainn kills Fer Diad with the dreadful Gáe Bulga and weeps over him. His father Sualtam's cry at Emain Macha rouses the Ulstermen from their debility. In the great battle at Gárech, Fergus keeps his promise and yields to Cú Chulainn, the host of the four provinces breaks, and Cú Chulainn spares Medb's life. But the Brown Bull has been driven to Connacht; through a whole night it fights the White-horned across Ireland, tears it to pieces, returns home, and dies when its heart breaks.

canonical_title: The Cattle Raid of Cooley, Part 1: Cú Chulainn at the fords
title_zh: 夺牛长征记 · 上部 库丘林守浅滩
summary_zh: 康诺特的女王梅芙和国王艾利尔在枕边比较财产，一切都相等，只差一头白角公牛。为了得到能与之相比的库利褐色公牛，梅芙集结了爱尔兰四省的大军进攻阿尔斯特。阿尔斯特的男人们正受着诅咒，陷入衰弱，只有十七岁的库丘林独自守卫边界。流亡的阿尔斯特人弗格斯在行军途中讲述了库丘林少年时的事迹：五岁打败一百五十个男孩，杀死铁匠库兰的猛犬而得名，在预言的那一天拿起武器。库丘林在浅滩上一天接一天地与对手决斗，拒绝了女神莫莉甘，又得到父亲鲁格的医治；当阿尔斯特的少年队为他战死时，他在狂暴的变身中向大军发起了大屠杀。
summary_en: Medb and Ailill, queen and king of Connacht, compare their possessions in bed and find them equal except for a white-horned bull. To win the matching Brown Bull of Cúailnge, Medb musters the four provinces of Ireland against Ulster. The Ulstermen lie under a curse of weakness, and the seventeen-year-old Cú Chulainn guards the border alone. On the march the exiled Ulsterman Fergus tells of Cú Chulainn's boyhood: beating a hundred and fifty boys at five, earning his name by killing the smith Culann's hound, taking arms on a day of prophecy. At the fords Cú Chulainn fights champion after champion, refuses the goddess Morrígan, is healed by his father Lugh, and when the boy-troop of Ulster dies for him, falls on the host in his battle-frenzy in a great slaughter.

canonical_title: The Rock-Cave Door and the Eight-Forked Serpent: the long story of Susanoo
title_zh: 天之岩户与八岐大蛇：须佐之男的长篇故事
summary_zh: 伊邪那岐把天上交给天照大神、夜之国交给月读、大海交给须佐之男。须佐之男却哭个不停，要去母亲所在的根之国，被父亲赶走。他上天向姐姐告别，两人在天安河边立誓生子；须佐之男自称得胜，在高天原胡作非为，害死了织女。天照大神躲进天之岩户，天地陷入长夜。八百万众神聚在河边商议，思金神出谋，造镜子与勾玉，天宇受卖命在岩户前狂舞，众神大笑，天照大神好奇开门，被天手力男神拉了出来。须佐之男被逐出天界，杀死大宜都比卖，五谷由此而生；他在出云救下栉名田比卖，用八坛烈酒灌醉八岐大蛇，斩杀它并从蛇尾得到草薙剑，最后在须贺建宫，唱出“八云立”之歌。
summary_en: Izanagi gives Heaven to Amaterasu, the night to Tsukuyomi and the sea to Susanoo, who weeps until the mountains wither and is banished. Going up to take leave of his sister, he swears an oath with her by the Tranquil River of Heaven; claiming victory, he runs riot and causes the death of a weaving maiden. Amaterasu hides in the Heavenly Rock-Dwelling and the world falls into night. The eight hundred myriad deities take counsel through Omoikane, make a mirror and jewels, and Ame-no-Uzume dances until they roar with laughter; Amaterasu peeps out and Tajikarao draws her forth. Expelled, Susanoo kills the food goddess, from whose body grain arises; in Izumo he saves Kushinadahime, makes the eight-forked serpent drunk, slays it, finds the Kusanagi sword in its tail and builds his palace at Suga.

canonical_title: Izanagi and Izanami — making the land, Yomi and purification
title_zh: 伊邪那岐与伊邪那美：造岛、黄泉与禊祓
summary_zh: 天神命伊邪那岐与伊邪那美巩固漂浮的大地。两神站在天浮桥上，用天沼矛搅动海水，滴下的盐水堆成淤能碁吕岛。伊邪那美生下火神后被烧伤而死；伊邪那岐追到黄泉，她却说已经吃了黄泉的食物。伊邪那岐回来后洗净身体，最后从左眼、右眼和鼻子生出天照大神、月读和须佐之男。
summary_en: The heavenly deities command Izanagi and Izanami to consolidate the drifting land. From the Floating Bridge of Heaven they stir the brine with a jewelled spear, and the drops become Onogoro Island. Izanami dies after bearing the fire deity; Izanagi follows her to Yomi, but she has already eaten of its hearth. Returning, he purifies himself, and from his left eye, right eye and nose are born Amaterasu, Tsukuyomi and Susanoo.

canonical_title: Kojiki, Part 4: the descent of the August Grandchild and the palace of the sea
title_zh: 古事记 · 第四部 天孙降临与海神之宫
summary_zh: 国土让出以后，天照大神的孙子迩迩艺命奉命降临。天之八衢上站着放光的猿田毘古神，天宇受卖命上前问话，他自愿为天孙引路。迩迩艺命带着五位随从神、勾玉、镜子和草薙剑，降落在日向的高千穗峰。他娶了大山津见神的女儿木花之佐久夜毘卖，却把丑陋的姐姐石长比卖送了回去，于是天孙子孙的寿命像花一样短暂。木花之佐久夜毘卖一夜受孕，被丈夫怀疑，就在火中生下三个儿子。小儿子山幸彦火远理命借来哥哥海幸彦的鱼钩，弄丢在海里；他乘竹笼小船来到海神之宫，娶了丰玉毘卖，从鲷鱼喉中找回鱼钩，带着潮盈珠与潮干珠回来降服了哥哥。丰玉毘卖在海边鸬鹚羽毛盖的产屋里生下孩子，被丈夫看见了大鳄的真身，从此关闭海路回到海中。
summary_en: With the land yielded, Amaterasu's grandson Ninigi is sent down. At the heavenly crossroads a shining deity, Sarutahiko, is questioned by Ame-no-Uzume and offers to guide the descent. Ninigi comes down on the peak of Takachiho in Himuka with five attendant deities, the jewels, the mirror and the Kusanagi sword. He marries Konohana-sakuya-hime, daughter of the mountain deity, but sends back her ugly elder sister Iwanaga-hime, so the lives of his descendants are as brief as blossoms. Doubted by her husband after conceiving in a single night, Konohana-sakuya-hime gives birth inside a burning hall to three sons. The youngest, Hoori, the Luck of the Mountains, loses his brother's fish-hook in the sea; he sails in a bamboo boat to the sea deity's palace, marries Toyotama-bime, recovers the hook from a sea-bream's throat and returns with the tide jewels to subdue his brother. Toyotama-bime gives birth on the shore in a hut thatched with cormorant feathers, is seen in her true form as a great wani, and closes the sea-road behind her.

canonical_title: Kojiki, Part 3: Ōkuninushi, from the hare of Inaba to the yielding of the land
title_zh: 古事记 · 第三部 大国主：从稻羽白兔到让国
summary_zh: 大国主是须佐之男的后代。他替八十位兄长背着袋子去稻羽求婚，路上治好了被剥了皮的白兔，白兔预言八上比卖会嫁给他。兄长们嫉恨他，两次把他害死，都被母亲求来的神救活。他逃到根之坚洲国，在须佐之男的女儿须势理毘卖帮助下熬过了蛇室、蜈蚣与蜂之室和火烧原野，最后背着她、带着须佐之男的生太刀、生弓矢和天诏琴逃回人间，成为“大国主”。他与小小的少名毘古那一起造国，又在御诸山供奉来自海上的神。天上的天照大神要她的子孙来统治这片土地：天菩比神和天若日子都没有回来复命，建御雷神坐在倒插的剑尖上逼问，儿子事代主答应、建御名方败逃，大国主终于让出国土，只求为他建一座高大的宫殿。
summary_en: Ōkuninushi is a descendant of Susanoo. Carrying the bag for his eighty brothers as they go to woo the princess of Inaba, he heals a skinned white hare, which foretells that the princess will choose him. His jealous brothers kill him twice, and twice he is restored by deities his mother calls down from heaven. He flees to the Nether-Distant-Land, where Susanoo's daughter Suseri-bime helps him survive the snake room, the centipede-and-wasp room and the burning moor; at last he escapes carrying her on his back with Susanoo's sword, bow and speaking lute, and becomes Master of the Great Land. He makes the land with the tiny Sukuna-bikona and enshrines a deity who comes over the sea on Mount Mimoro. Amaterasu wants her descendants to rule the land: the envoys Ame-no-hohi and Ame-no-Wakahiko never report back, Takemikazuchi sits cross-legged on the point of an upturned sword, Kotoshironushi agrees and Takeminakata flees, and Ōkuninushi yields the land, asking only for a great palace.

canonical_title: Kojiki, Part 5: Yamato Takeru
title_zh: 古事记 · 第五部 倭建命
summary_zh: 景行天皇的儿子小碓命性情凶猛，父亲害怕他，就派他去西方讨伐熊曾建。他借来姑母倭比卖的衣裳，扮成少女混进宴会，刺杀了熊曾兄弟，垂死的弟弟献给他“倭建”的名号。他在出云用木刀骗杀了出云建，回到京城，父亲又立刻派他去东方。他在伊势向姑母哭诉父亲想让他死，姑母给了他草薙剑和一个袋子。在相武的原野上，他用剑割草、用袋中的火石点起逆火，逃出火海；渡海时弟橘比卖投身海中平息风浪。他在足柄坂上叹息“吾妻哉”，在酒折宫与火守老人联句。回到尾张，他娶了美夜受比卖，却把草薙剑留在她身边，空手去讨伐伊吹山的神，被冰雹击伤。他拖着病体一路走一路唱，在能烦野唱着思念故乡大和的歌死去，化作一只白鸟飞向天空。
summary_en: Keikō's son Wo-usu is so fierce that his father fears him and sends him west against the Kumaso bravoes. Disguised as a girl in his aunt Yamato-hime's robes, he kills the two brothers at their feast, and the dying younger brother gives him the name Yamato Takeru. He kills the Izumo bravo with a wooden-sword trick, returns, and is at once sent east. At Ise he weeps to his aunt that his father wishes him dead; she gives him the Kusanagi sword and a bag. On the moor of Sagamu he mows the grass and lights a counter-fire to escape the flames; at sea Oto-tachibana-hime gives herself to the waves to calm them. On the Ashigara pass he sighs 'Alas, my wife!', and at Sakaori he finishes a poem with an old fire-keeper. Back in Owari he marries Miyazu-hime but leaves the sword with her and goes bare-handed against the deity of Mount Ibuki, who strikes him with hail. Sick, he walks on singing, dies at Nobo singing of his longing for Yamato, and turns into a white bird that flies into the sky.

editorial_note: 依据张伯伦 1882 年英译《古事记》第七十九至九十节（景行天皇纪第四至十五部分，sacred-texts 页码 kj086–kj097），按节顺序讲述；书中的歌只讲大意，不转录译文。故事开头小碓命杀兄的情节照原书交代结果，不渲染细节。《日本书纪》中的倭建命故事有不少不同之处，另行处理。

canonical_title: Churning of the Sea of Milk as an Angkor Wat material witness
title_zh: 吴哥寺乳海搅拌：浮雕物质见证
summary_zh: APSARA 把吴哥寺东侧回廊南段浮雕标为“乳海搅拌”；本站把它登记为有现实位置的高棉物质见证，不据图像补写一部完整梵文故事。
summary_en: APSARA identifies the relief in the southern section of Angkor Wat's eastern gallery as the Churning of the Sea of Milk; the site records it as a locatable Khmer material witness without reconstructing a complete Sanskrit narrative from the image.

title_zh: 毛利创世传统：不是单一版本

summary_en: Te Ara explicitly states that Maori iwi preserve many creation traditions and that not all iwi have an Io tradition; this page presents only the public layer and its access boundary.

canonical_title: Three Maya gods in stone, clay and glyph
title_zh: 石头、陶盘与文字中的三位玛雅神
summary_zh: 三份独立见证，各讲一位玛雅神：奇琴伊察的卡斯蒂略金字塔又叫“库库尔坎神庙”；大都会博物馆的一只陶盘上，雨神恰克半身浸在水中；同一博物馆的展览介绍年老的天神伊察姆纳和他的鸟形化身。三份见证分开阅读，不拼成一个统一神话。
summary_en: Three separate witnesses, one god each: Chichen-Itza's El Castillo is also called the Temple of Kukulkan; a Met plate shows the rain god Chahk waist-deep in water; and a Met exhibition presents the aged sky god Itzamnaaj and his bird avatar. They are read separately, not stitched into one myth.
themes_json: ["库库尔坎", "恰克", "伊察姆纳", "物质见证"]
editorial_note: 三个版本分别来自联合国教科文组织遗产记录与大都会艺术博物馆的两份说明；不把玛雅与墨西加的羽蛇神合并。

canonical_title: Hero Twins and Seven Macaw — a public K'iche'-attributed overview
title_zh: 英雄双子与七金刚鹦鹉：公开基切语境见证
summary_zh: Smithsonian 的公开页面把胡纳普与伊斯巴兰克作为英雄双子，并叙述他们击败七金刚鹦鹉；本站只建立这一可公开定位的事件，不把它扩写成全体玛雅的标准故事。
summary_en: A public Smithsonian page presents Hunahpu and Xbalanque as the Hero Twins and says they defeat Seven Macaw; this record models only that locatable episode and does not turn it into a standard story for all Maya communities.

canonical_title: The birth of Huitzilopochtli on Serpent Mountain
title_zh: 蛇山上的诞生：维齐洛波奇特利
summary_zh: 科阿特利库埃在蛇山打扫时，一团羽毛飘落，她把它塞在腰间，因此怀孕。女儿科约尔沙乌基认为这是耻辱，带着四百个兄弟要杀死母亲。就在他们冲上山顶时，维齐洛波奇特利全副武装地出生，砍下科约尔沙乌基的头，把兄弟们赶散。
summary_en: While sweeping on Coatepec, Coatlicue picks up a ball of feathers, tucks it at her waist and conceives. Her daughter Coyolxauhqui, shamed, leads the four hundred brothers to kill their mother. As they reach the summit, Huitzilopochtli is born fully armed, beheads Coyolxauhqui and scatters the brothers.
themes_json: ["诞生", "战神", "蛇山", "墨西加"]
editorial_note: 依据《佛罗伦萨手抄本》第三卷第1章（萨阿贡编纂，16世纪）；学者把这段故事与大神庙布局相联系属于解释层。

canonical_title: Quetzalcoatl and Titlacauan at Tollan
title_zh: 图拉的羽蛇神与蒂特拉卡瓦
summary_zh: 《佛罗伦萨手抄本》第三卷讲述图拉的大法师羽蛇神。巫师们来到他身边，其中一位叫蒂特拉卡瓦，也就是特斯卡特利波卡；他们带来的种种征兆让羽蛇神的荣光走向终结。羽蛇神离开时，随行的人在两座雪山之间冻死。
summary_en: Florentine Codex Book 3 tells of Quetzalcoatl, a great wizard at Tollan. Sorcerers come to him — among them Titlacauan, also called Tezcatlipoca — and their portents bring his glory to an end. As he departs, his followers freeze to death between two snow-capped volcanoes.
themes_json: ["羽蛇神", "特斯卡特利波卡", "图拉", "离去"]
editorial_note: 依据第三卷第2–5、14章的章节标题与概要；各章细节尚未逐段建模。

canonical_title: Two gods on one pyramid — the Templo Mayor
title_zh: 一座金字塔上的两位神：大神庙
summary_zh: 特诺奇蒂特兰的大神庙顶上并立着两座神殿：南边供奉太阳战神、墨西加人的守护神维齐洛波奇特利，北边供奉与农业相连的雨神特拉洛克。墨西哥国家人类学与历史研究所说，神庙始建于1325年，此后多次重建与扩建。
summary_en: Atop the Templo Mayor of Tenochtitlan stood two shrines: on the south, Huitzilopochtli, solar god of war and patron of the Mexica; on the north, Tlaloc, god of rain linked to agriculture. INAH says the first small temple was built at the city's founding in 1325 and was rebuilt and enlarged many times.
themes_json: ["大神庙", "战争与雨水", "考古遗址"]
editorial_note: 现实遗址层：依据墨西哥国家人类学与历史研究所（INAH）遗址博物馆的公开说明；不推测坐标。

canonical_title: Ask and Embla in two witnesses
title_zh: 阿斯克与恩布拉：两种北欧见证
summary_zh: 《女巫预言》与《欺骗古鲁菲》都记下最初人类阿斯克和恩布拉，却给出不同的神祇组合；两版分开阅读。
summary_en: Voluspa and Gylfaginning both name Ask and Embla while presenting different divine triads; the two witnesses are read separately.

canonical_title: Forging the divine treasures
title_zh: 诸神宝物的锻造
summary_zh: 《诗语法》保存矮人锻造竞赛的故事层，并把古林博斯帝、德罗普尼尔和妙尔尼尔放在同一宝物序列中。
summary_en: Skaldskaparmal preserves the smithing-contest layer that places Gullinbursti, Draupnir, and Mjolnir in one treasure sequence.

editorial_note: 长篇版本依据斯诺里《埃达·诗语法》第35章逐段讲述希芙的金发与六件宝物的来历，开头关于乌勒尔的一章据《欺骗古鲁菲》第31章；原有的三段概述版本保留。锻造矮人在《诗语法》中称埃特里，有些抄本与后人作辛德里，名称异文仍独立记录。

canonical_title: Frigg's oaths and the death of Baldr
title_zh: 弗丽嘉的誓言与巴德尔之死
summary_zh: 弗丽嘉是奥丁的妻子，知道一切命运。她的儿子巴德尔梦见自己有危险，她便让火、水、金属、石头、草木和野兽都发誓不伤害他——唯独漏掉了一株幼小的槲寄生。巴德尔最后正是被槲寄生杀死的。
summary_en: Frigg, Odin's wife, knows all fates. When her son Baldr dreams of danger, she makes fire, water, metals, stones, plants and beasts swear not to harm him — all except a young shoot of mistletoe. In the end it is mistletoe that kills Baldr.

editorial_note: 依据《欺骗古鲁菲》第20、49章；之后的冥界求情与报复情节尚未逐段登记。

canonical_title: Thor recovers Mjolnir
title_zh: 索尔寻找被夺走的妙尔尼尔
summary_zh: 《索列姆之歌》以索尔寻找锤子为中心，洛基同行并提供协助；本页不把二者误写成兄弟。
summary_en: Thrymskvida centers on Thor seeking his hammer, with Loki accompanying and advising him; the page does not call them brothers.

canonical_title: Heimdallr, watchman of the gods
title_zh: 海姆达尔：众神的守望者
summary_zh: 海姆达尔住在彩虹桥边的希敏约格，替众神守着桥，防备山巨人。他睡得比鸟还少，夜里能看见一百里远，连草和羊毛生长的声音都听得见。他有一支加拉尔号角，吹响时所有世界都能听到。人们还说他是九位姐妹母亲的儿子。
summary_en: Heimdallr lives at Himinbjörg beside the rainbow bridge Bifröst and guards it for the gods against the mountain-giants. He needs less sleep than a bird, sees a hundred leagues by night, and hears grass and wool growing. His horn Gjallarhorn can be heard in all worlds, and he is called the son of nine mothers who were sisters.
themes_json: ["守望者", "号角", "彩虹桥"]
editorial_note: 依据《欺骗古鲁菲》第27章。

canonical_title: Odin and Mimirs well
title_zh: 奥丁与密米尔之泉
summary_zh: 《欺骗古鲁菲》第15章把密米尔与智慧之泉相连，并说奥丁以一只眼睛换取饮泉的机会。
summary_en: Gylfaginning 15 associates Mimir with the well of wisdom and says that Odin gives an eye for a drink.
