canonical_title: Ragnarök: the destruction and renewal of the world
title_zh: 诸神黄昏：世界的毁灭与重生
summary_zh: 斯诺里的《欺骗古鲁菲》讲述了诸神黄昏的全过程：芬布尔之冬、狼吞日月、锁链断裂、诸神与巨人在维格利德平原决战、奥丁、索尔、弗雷、提尔与海姆达尔相继战死，苏尔特的火焰烧毁了整个世界；之后大地从海中重新升起，幸存的众神与两个人类开始了新的世界。原有的三段纲要版本保留，长篇版本按第51–54章逐段讲述。
summary_en: Snorri's Gylfaginning tells the whole of Ragnarök: the Fimbulwinter, the wolves swallowing sun and moon, the breaking of every fetter, the last battle of gods and giants on the plain of Vígríðr, the deaths of Odin, Thor, Freyr, Týr and Heimdall, and Surtr's fire burning the world; then the earth rises green from the sea and surviving gods and two humans begin a new world. The earlier three-part outline is kept; the long version follows chapters 51–54 section by section.
themes_json: ["终末","更新","奥丁","芬里尔"]
editorial_note: 长篇版本依据斯诺里《欺骗古鲁菲》第51–54章，斯诺里在其中大量引用《女巫的预言》等埃达诗；本篇只讲斯诺里的散文版本，不用流行文化补齐。原有纲要版本保留其缺口说明。

canonical_title: Thor and Hrungnir: the stone-hearted giant and three-year-old Magni
title_zh: 索尔与赫朗格尼尔：石心巨人与三岁的马格尼
summary_zh: 奥丁骑着八足马斯莱普尼尔来到巨人国，与最强壮的巨人赫朗格尼尔赛马，一路追进了阿斯加尔德。众神请赫朗格尼尔喝酒，他喝醉了，扬言要把瓦尔哈拉搬回巨人国、杀光众神，只留下芙蕾雅和希芙。索尔回来后，巨人约他在边境的格约特纳加尔德决斗。巨人们用黏土造了一个九里高的泥巨人，给它装上一颗母马的心；赫朗格尼尔自己有一颗三角形的石心，拿着石盾和磨石。索尔的仆人提亚尔菲骗巨人站到盾牌上，索尔的锤子与巨人的磨石在空中相撞，磨石碎裂，一块嵌进索尔的头里，锤子砸碎了巨人的头颅。巨人倒下时一条腿压在索尔的脖子上，众神都抬不动，只有索尔三岁的儿子马格尼把它推开。最后，女巫格罗亚为索尔念咒取石，却因为听到丈夫奥尔万迪尔快要回来的好消息，高兴得忘了咒语，磨石从此留在了索尔的头里。
summary_en: Óðinn rides Sleipnir to Jötunheimr and races Hrungnir, strongest of the giants, all the way into Ásgarðr. The gods give Hrungnir drink; drunk, he boasts that he will carry Valhalla off to Jötunheimr and kill all the gods except Freyja and Sif. When Thor returns, the giant challenges him to a duel at Grjótúnagarðar on the border. The giants build a clay giant nine leagues tall and give it a mare's heart; Hrungnir himself has a three-cornered heart of stone and carries a stone shield and a whetstone. Thor's servant Thjálfi tricks the giant into standing on his shield; Thor's hammer and the giant's whetstone meet in the air, the whetstone shatters, a piece lodges in Thor's head, and the hammer crushes the giant's skull. Hrungnir falls with his leg across Thor's neck; none of the gods can lift it until Thor's three-year-old son Magni throws it off. At last the seeress Gróa chants to draw out the stone, but forgets her spells for joy at the news that her husband Aurvandill is coming home, and the whetstone stays in Thor's head.

editorial_note: 依据斯诺里《埃达·诗语法》第17章（布罗德尔英译本的章节编号）逐段讲述。斯诺里讲这个故事，是为了解释吟唱诗人图约多尔夫的《秋长诗》等诗中的典故，诗中的细节与散文有时不同，这里只讲散文。

canonical_title: Thor in the castle of Útgarða-Loki
title_zh: 索尔在乌特加尔洛基的城堡
summary_zh: 索尔和洛基驾着山羊车东行，在农夫家吃了山羊又让它们复活，收下夏尔菲和罗斯克娃做仆人。他们在巨人斯克里米尔的手套里过夜，打不开他的口袋，三锤也打不醒他。到了乌特加尔洛基的城堡，洛基比吃、夏尔菲赛跑、索尔喝角杯、举猫、与老妇角力，全都输了。离开时巨人王才说出真相：他们的对手是火、思想、大海、世界之蛇和衰老。后来索尔又去海上垂钓世界之蛇。
summary_en: Thor and Loki drive east in Thor's goat chariot, eat the goats and raise them again, and take Þjálfi and Röskva as servants. They sleep in a giant's glove, cannot open his food bag, and cannot wake him with three hammer blows. At Útgarðr they lose every contest — eating, racing, drinking from a horn, lifting a cat, wrestling an old woman — until the giant king reveals as they leave that they were pitted against fire, thought, the sea, the Midgard Serpent and old age. Afterwards Thor goes fishing for the Serpent.
editorial_note: 依据《欺骗古鲁菲》第44–48章；斯诺里以“对话中讲故事”的框架写成，本站按章节顺序独立讲述。

canonical_title: Týr's hand and the binding of Fenrir
title_zh: 提尔的手：束缚芬里尔
summary_zh: 提尔是众神中最勇敢的一位。众神要捆住越长越大的狼芬里尔，狼要求有人把手放进它嘴里作担保。只有提尔伸出了右手；当狼发现自己挣脱不开，就咬断了他的手。所以提尔只有一只手。
summary_en: Týr is the boldest of the gods. When they set out to bind the growing wolf Fenrir, the wolf demands a hand in its mouth as a pledge. Only Týr offers his right hand; when the wolf finds it cannot break free, it bites the hand off — and so Týr is one-handed.
themes_json: ["芬里尔", "勇气", "誓约"]
editorial_note: 依据《欺骗古鲁菲》第25、34章；芬里尔在诸神黄昏中的结局见既有故事。

canonical_title: Njörðr, Freyr and Freyja — the Vanir family
title_zh: 华纳神族：尼奥尔德、弗雷与芙蕾雅
summary_zh: 尼奥尔德住在诺欧通，掌管风和海，原本在华纳海姆长大，作为人质来到阿萨神族。他的儿子弗雷掌管雨水、阳光和丰收；女儿芙蕾雅住在弗尔克范格，每次出征都分走一半战死者，乘坐两只猫拉的车。弗雷后来为了娶葛德，交出了自己的宝剑。
summary_en: Njörðr lives at Nóatún and rules wind and sea; raised in Vanaheim, he came to the Æsir as a hostage. His son Freyr rules rain, sunshine and harvests; his daughter Freyja lives at Fólkvangr, takes half the slain and drives a chariot pulled by two cats. Later Freyr gives away his sword to win Gerðr.
themes_json: ["华纳神族", "海洋", "丰收", "芙蕾雅"]

canonical_title: The Saga of the Völsungs, Part 1: Sigmund
title_zh: 沃尔松格萨迦 · 第一部 西格蒙德
summary_zh: 沃尔松格家族是奥丁的后裔。国王沃尔松格的大厅里长着一棵巨大的橡树，在女儿西格妮的婚宴上，一个独眼的老人把一把剑插进了树干，只有西格蒙德能把它拔出来。新郎西格尔国王因此怀恨在心，设计杀死了沃尔松格和他的九个儿子，只有西格蒙德在妹妹西格妮的帮助下活了下来。为了复仇，西格妮化身为女巫与哥哥同眠，生下了辛菲奥特利；父子二人在森林里披上狼皮，最终烧死了西格尔，西格妮也随丈夫投身火海。多年以后，奥丁亲手用长矛折断了西格蒙德的剑，西格蒙德战死，把宝剑的碎片留给了尚未出生的儿子西古尔德。
summary_en: The Völsungs descend from Odin. In King Völsungr's hall grows a great oak, and at his daughter Signý's wedding a one-eyed old man thrusts a sword into its trunk that only Sigmundr can draw. The bridegroom, King Siggeir, takes offence and destroys Völsungr and his nine sons; only Sigmundr survives with Signý's help. Bent on vengeance, Signý takes another woman's shape to lie with her brother and bears Sinfjötli; father and son put on wolf-skins in the forest and at last burn Siggeir in his hall, and Signý goes back into the fire to die with her husband. Years later Odin himself breaks Sigmundr's sword with his spear; Sigmundr falls and leaves the shards for his unborn son, Sigurðr.

canonical_title: The Saga of the Völsungs, Part 3: Sigurd and Brynhild
title_zh: 沃尔松格萨迦 · 第三部 西古尔德与布伦希尔德
summary_zh: 西古尔德来到居基王的宫廷，王后格里姆希尔德给他喝下遗忘之酒，他忘记了布伦希尔德，娶了公主古德伦，与她的兄弟贡纳尔、霍格尼结为兄弟。格里姆希尔德又让贡纳尔去向布伦希尔德求婚，可是只有能骑马穿过火墙的人才能娶她。西古尔德变成贡纳尔的模样穿过火焰，与布伦希尔德同住三夜，中间放着出鞘的格拉姆，又取走了安德瓦拉诺特。多年后，两位王后在河边争吵，古德伦亮出那枚戒指，真相大白。布伦希尔德悲愤欲绝，要求贡纳尔杀死西古尔德。西古尔德被谋杀在床上，布伦希尔德也随他而去，与他一起被火化。
summary_en: Sigurðr comes to the court of King Gjúki, where Queen Grímhildr gives him a drink of forgetfulness; he forgets Brynhildr, marries the princess Guðrún and swears brotherhood with her brothers Gunnarr and Högni. Grímhildr then sends Gunnarr to woo Brynhildr, who will wed only the man who rides through her wall of fire. In Gunnarr's shape Sigurðr rides the flames and spends three nights with her, the naked Gram between them, taking back Andvaranautr. Years later the two queens quarrel at the river and Guðrún shows the ring; the truth comes out. Brynhildr, in grief and fury, demands Sigurðr's death; he is murdered in his bed, and Brynhildr follows him, burned on his pyre.

canonical_title: The Saga of the Völsungs, Part 2: Sigurd the dragon-slayer
title_zh: 沃尔松格萨迦 · 第二部 屠龙者西古尔德
summary_zh: 西古尔德在丹麦国王的宫中长大，由矮人般的铁匠雷金抚养，在奥丁的指点下选中了骏马格拉尼。雷金讲述了一段带着诅咒的黄金的来历：洛基杀死了他的兄弟奥特，众神从矮人安德瓦利那里夺来黄金作为赎金，安德瓦利诅咒了黄金和戒指；他的另一个兄弟法夫纳为了黄金杀死了父亲，变成了恶龙。雷金用西格蒙德留下的碎片重铸了宝剑格拉姆，西古尔德为父亲报了仇，又在坑中刺死了法夫纳。他尝到龙心的血，听懂了鸟语，杀死了想要背叛他的雷金，带着黄金来到山上，唤醒了被奥丁用睡眠之刺惩罚的女武神布伦希尔德，两人许下了婚誓。
summary_en: Sigurðr grows up at the Danish court, fostered by the dwarf-like smith Reginn, and with Odin's advice chooses the horse Grani. Reginn tells of cursed gold: Loki killed his brother Otr, the gods took the dwarf Andvari's hoard as ransom and Andvari cursed the gold and his ring; his other brother Fáfnir killed their father for it and became a dragon. Reginn reforges Sigmundr's shards into the sword Gram; Sigurðr avenges his father and stabs Fáfnir from a pit. Tasting the dragon's heart-blood he understands the birds, kills the treacherous Reginn, carries off the gold, and on a mountain wakes the shield-maiden Brynhildr, whom Odin had pricked with the sleep-thorn, and they plight their troth.

canonical_title: Ymir and the shaping of the world
title_zh: 尤弥尔与世界的形成
summary_zh: 太初有一道深渊，北方的寒霜遇到南方的热气，化出巨人尤弥尔。后来奥丁和他的兄弟维利、维杀死了尤弥尔，用他的身体造出世界：肉成了大地，血成了海洋和湖泊，骨头成了山石，头骨成了天空。
summary_en: In the beginning there is a great void where rime from the north meets heat from the south, and from it the giant Ymir arises. Later Odin and his brothers Vili and Vé kill Ymir and build the world from his body: his flesh becomes the earth, his blood the sea and lakes, his bones the rocks, his skull the sky.

editorial_note: 长篇版本依据斯诺里《埃达·欺骗古鲁菲》第4–12章逐章讲述，包括布里、博尔、约尔德与日月的来历；原有的第5–8章概述版本保留。《女巫的预言》等诗歌见证另行对读，不并入。

canonical_title: Shahnameh, Part 2: the seven stages of Rostam
title_zh: 列王纪 · 第二部 鲁斯塔姆的七关
summary_zh: 伊朗国王凯·卡乌斯听了一个魔鬼扮成的歌手赞美马赞德兰的歌，不顾扎尔的劝告，率军去征服这片魔鬼之地，结果被白魔用黑云和冰雹弄瞎了双眼，连同大军一起被俘。鲁斯塔姆骑着拉赫什，选择了一条近而险的路去营救国王，一路闯过七关：拉赫什杀死了扑来的狮子；一只公羊把渴得昏倒的他引到泉边；拉赫什三次唤醒他，与他一起杀死了恶龙；他识破了化作美女的女巫；他擒住乌拉德做向导；他斩下了阿尔章魔的头；最后他趁正午魔鬼们沉睡，闯进白魔的洞穴，杀死白魔，取出它的肝，用它的血让国王和勇士们重见光明。随后，马赞德兰国王在战斗中把自己变成一块岩石，被鲁斯塔姆扛回营中逼了出来。可是凯·卡乌斯并没有吸取教训：他又听了魔鬼的话，用四只饥饿的鹰拉着宝座想飞上天空，最后从空中跌进了森林，又一次需要鲁斯塔姆去把他找回来。
summary_en: Kay Kāvus, shah of Iran, hears a demon disguised as a minstrel sing the praises of Māzandarān and, ignoring Zāl's warnings, marches to conquer that land of demons — only to be blinded with his whole army by the White Demon's dark cloud and hail and taken captive. Riding Rakhsh, Rostam takes the short and perilous road to rescue him and passes seven stages: Rakhsh kills a lion; a ram leads him, fainting with thirst, to a spring; Rakhsh wakes him three times and helps him kill a dragon; he unmasks a witch disguised as a fair woman; he captures Olād as his guide; he tears off the head of the demon Arzhang; and at last, at noon when the demons sleep, he enters the White Demon's cave, kills him and with the blood of his liver restores the sight of the shah and his warriors. The king of Māzandarān turns himself into a rock in battle and is carried back to camp by Rostam until he comes out. But Kay Kāvus learns nothing: tempted again by a demon, he tries to fly to heaven on a throne drawn by four hungry eagles, crashes into a forest, and once more must be found by Rostam.

canonical_title: Shahnameh, Part 3: Rostam and Sohrāb
title_zh: 列王纪 · 第三部 鲁斯塔姆与苏赫拉布
summary_zh: 鲁斯塔姆在边境打猎时，拉赫什被人偷走，他一路追到萨曼甘国。夜里，公主塔米娜来到他的房中，说她仰慕他已久，愿嫁给他，为他生一个儿子。两人成婚，鲁斯塔姆临别时留下一枚臂环，说生了儿子就戴在他的手臂上。孩子苏赫拉布长得飞快，十岁就无人能敌。他从母亲那里得知父亲是鲁斯塔姆，就决心率军攻入伊朗，推翻凯·卡乌斯，让父亲做国王。图兰王阿夫拉西亚布暗中命令将领们不让父子相认，盼着两人自相残杀。苏赫拉布攻下白堡，被女战士戈尔达法丽德用计脱身；凯·卡乌斯急召鲁斯塔姆，又因他迟到而发怒。两军对阵，苏赫拉布一再问起鲁斯塔姆，伊朗的俘虏却骗他说鲁斯塔姆不在军中，鲁斯塔姆自己也隐瞒了名字。父子二人斗了三天：第一天不分胜负，第二天苏赫拉布摔倒了父亲却被骗放过了他，第三天鲁斯塔姆向神求回力气，把苏赫拉布摔倒，一剑刺进了他的胸膛。苏赫拉布临死说出父亲的名字，鲁斯塔姆看见了臂环，悲痛欲绝。他派人向凯·卡乌斯求取长生药，国王却迟迟不给，苏赫拉布死在了父亲的怀里。
summary_en: Hunting on the border, Rostam loses Rakhsh to thieves and tracks him to Samangān. At night the princess Tahmineh comes to his chamber, saying she has long admired him and wishes to marry him and bear his son. They marry, and when he leaves he gives her an armlet: if a son is born, let him wear it on his arm. The boy, Sohrāb, grows wondrously fast and at ten has no equal. Learning from his mother that his father is Rostam, he resolves to invade Iran, overthrow Kay Kāvus and make his father king. Afrāsiyāb of Tūrān secretly orders his generals to keep father and son apart, hoping one will kill the other. Sohrāb takes the White Castle, from which the warrior maiden Gordāfarid escapes him by a ruse; Kay Kāvus summons Rostam and rages at his delay. When the armies meet, Sohrāb asks again and again for Rostam, but an Iranian captive tells him Rostam is not there, and Rostam himself hides his name. Father and son fight for three days: the first undecided; on the second Sohrāb throws his father but is tricked into sparing him; on the third Rostam, his strength restored by prayer, throws Sohrāb and drives a dagger into his breast. Dying, Sohrāb names his father; Rostam sees the armlet and is broken with grief. He sends to Kay Kāvus for the elixir of life, but the king delays, and Sohrāb dies in his father's arms.

canonical_title: Shahnameh, Part 1: Zāl and Rūdābeh
title_zh: 列王纪 · 第一部 扎尔与鲁达贝
summary_zh: 伊朗的勇士萨姆生了一个满头白发的儿子，他以为这是魔鬼的孩子，羞愧地把婴儿丢弃在厄尔布尔士山上。神鸟西摩格把孩子带回巢中抚养长大。多年后，萨姆在梦中受到责备，悔恨地上山寻子，西摩格把扎尔送下山，赠他一根羽毛，危急时焚烧就能召唤她。扎尔在喀布尔爱上了国王梅赫拉布的女儿鲁达贝，她在塔上放下长发让他攀援，他却用套索登上了塔楼。因为梅赫拉布是暴君佐哈克的后裔，萨姆和国王马努切赫尔都反对这门婚事；星象家却预言这对夫妇会生下一位伟大的英雄，王后辛多赫特亲自去说服萨姆，扎尔在宫廷里答出了智者们的谜语，婚事终于成就。鲁达贝怀了一个巨大的孩子，难产垂危，扎尔焚烧羽毛，西摩格教他剖开母亲的腹侧取出婴儿，这就是鲁斯塔姆。少年鲁斯塔姆一杵打死了发狂的白象，又从马群中套住了一匹玫瑰色斑纹的小马——拉赫什，从此人与马形影不离。
summary_en: Sām, champion of Iran, has a son born with white hair; thinking him a demon's child, he exposes the baby in shame on Mount Alborz, where the great bird Simorgh raises him. Years later, rebuked in a dream, Sām repents and seeks his son; the Simorgh brings Zāl down and gives him a feather to burn when he needs her. In Kābul Zāl falls in love with Rūdābeh, daughter of King Mehrāb; she lets down her long hair from her tower for him to climb, but he climbs by his lasso. Because Mehrāb descends from the tyrant Zahhāk, Sām and King Manūchehr both oppose the match; but the astrologers foretell a great hero from it, Queen Sindokht goes herself to win Sām over, and Zāl answers the riddles of the king's wise men, so the marriage is made. Rūdābeh carries a giant child and is near death in labour; Zāl burns the feather, and the Simorgh teaches him to open her side and draw out the child: Rostam. As a boy Rostam kills a raging white elephant with one blow, and from the herds he lassos a rose-dappled colt, Rakhsh, who will never leave his side.

canonical_title: The idols on the Kyiv hill — Perun and Mokosh
title_zh: 基辅山岗上的神像：佩伦与莫科什
summary_zh: 《往年纪事》980 年条：弗拉基米尔在基辅宫殿外的山岗上立起神像——银头金须的木雕佩伦，还有霍尔斯、达日博格、斯特里博格、西马尔格尔和莫科什，人们向它们献祭。988 年他受洗后下令推倒神像，佩伦被绑在马尾上拖下山，丢进第聂伯河。
summary_en: The Primary Chronicle's annal for 980: Volodimer sets up idols on the hill outside his Kyiv palace — a wooden Perun with a silver head and golden moustache, then Khors, Dazhbog, Stribog, Simargl and Mokosh — and people make offerings to them. After his baptism in 988 he has them cast down; Perun is tied to a horse's tail, dragged down the hill and thrown into the Dnieper.

editorial_note: 依据《往年纪事》980 与 988 年条；编年史由皈依后的基督教修士编写，对旧信仰的描述带有立场；莫科什在此只有名字。

canonical_title: Enki and Ninhursaĝa in Dilmun
title_zh: 恩基与宁胡尔萨格：迪尔蒙的植物
summary_zh: 故事从纯净的迪尔蒙开始。恩基吃掉了那里长出的植物，宁胡尔萨格怒而诅咒他，恩基因此病倒。后来宁胡尔萨格回心转意，为恩基身上每一处病痛生出一位神灵，把他治好。
summary_en: The story begins in pure Dilmun. Enki eats the plants that have grown there; Ninhursaĝa curses him in anger, and he falls ill. Later she relents and brings forth a deity for each ailing part of his body, healing him.
themes_json: ["迪尔蒙", "诅咒", "治愈"]
editorial_note: 依据 ETCSL 1.1.1 综合文本；植物与疗愈神的名单尚未逐项建模。

canonical_title: Utu helps Gilgameš set out against Ḫuwawa
title_zh: 太阳神乌图与吉尔伽美什的远征
summary_zh: 吉尔伽美什决定进山建立名声。伙伴恩奇都提醒他：山是太阳神乌图的事，得先告诉乌图。吉尔伽美什向乌图祈求，乌图接受了他的眼泪作为礼物，赐给他七位勇士做向导，去面对山中的守护者胡瓦瓦。
summary_en: Gilgameš resolves to make his name in the mountains. His companion Enkidu warns that the mountains are Utu's concern, so the sun god must be told. Gilgameš prays, and Utu accepts his tears as a gift and grants him seven warriors as guides to face Ḫuwawa, the guardian of the mountains.

canonical_title: Inana and Ebiḫ: the mountain that would not bow
title_zh: 伊南娜与埃比赫：不肯低头的山
summary_zh: 这首苏美尔颂歌先赞美伊南娜的可怖：她披着恐怖，在战斗中奔驰，在天上和地上像狮子一样吼叫。接着，伊南娜说出她的愤怒：她在天地间巡行，来到埃比赫山，这座山却没有向她低头，没有把鼻子贴在地上，没有用嘴唇亲吻尘土。她发誓要让恐怖充满这座高耸的山脉。她穿上庄严的服饰，来到天神安的面前，向父亲诉说，请他允许她去毁灭埃比赫。安却警告她：这座山令众神的居所都充满恐惧，它的果实丰美，林中满是狮子和野牛，你这个小女儿要去做什么？伊南娜怒不可遏，打开了武库的大门，带着风暴和洪水冲向埃比赫，把它毁灭。最后，她站在山的废墟上宣告：正因为你高耸、美丽，却不肯向我低头，我才杀死了你。诗以对伊南娜的赞美结束。
summary_en: This Sumerian hymn first praises Inana's terror: clad in fear, she rushes into battle and roars like a lion in heaven and on earth. Then Inana tells her anger: walking through heaven and earth she came to the mountain range Ebiḫ, but it did not bow to her, did not put its nose to the ground nor rub its lips in the dust. She vows to fill the soaring range with her terror. Putting on her majestic garments, she goes before An, the sky god, and asks her father's leave to destroy Ebiḫ. But An warns her: this mountain has spread terror even over the dwellings of the gods; its fruits are rich, its forests full of lions and wild bulls — what is my little one taking on? Inana, in fury, throws open the gate of her arsenal, rushes on Ebiḫ with storm and flood, and destroys it. Last, standing on the ruin, she declares: because you were lofty and beautiful yet would not bow to me, I have killed you. The poem ends in praise of Inana.

editorial_note: 依据牛津大学苏美尔文学电子文本语料库（ETCSL）所收《伊南娜与埃比赫》合成文本，按段落顺序讲述。这首诗由多块古巴比伦时期的泥板拼合而成，个别诗行残缺或意义不明，本篇只讲能读通的部分。后世传统把它归于阿卡德公主、乌尔的女祭司恩赫杜安娜，作者归属尚有争议。埃比赫通常被认为是今伊拉克的哈姆林山。

canonical_title: Nanna-Suen sails to Nibru
title_zh: 月神南纳航向尼普尔
summary_zh: 月神南纳想念父亲恩利尔的城市尼普尔，便装满一船礼物，沿河航行前往。到了尼普尔，恩利尔欢迎他，赐给他满船的丰饶，让他带回自己的城市乌尔。
summary_en: The moon god Nanna-Suen longs for Nibru, the city of his father Enlil. He loads a boat with gifts and sails there; Enlil welcomes him and grants him abundance to carry home to his own city, Urim.

canonical_title: The palace of Baal: El, Athirat and the house of silver and gold
title_zh: 巴力的宫殿：伊勒、阿西拉特与银金之屋
summary_zh: 战胜海神雅姆以后，风暴之神巴力在宴会上饮酒，女战神阿娜特在山谷中大战，然后洗净双手。巴力派使者请阿娜特来到萨方山，告诉她自己的苦恼：众神都有房子，唯独巴力没有。阿娜特闯进众神之父伊勒的住所，威胁要让他的白发流血，却没能得到允许。巴力请工匠之神科塔尔-瓦-哈西斯用金银打造宝座、桌子和碗盏，作为礼物送给众神之母阿西拉特。阿西拉特在海边纺线，起初以为巴力和阿娜特来杀她的儿子，看见金银才高兴起来。她骑着驴去见伊勒，伊勒笑着请她吃喝，问她是不是想念他的爱；阿西拉特说：我们的王是强大的巴力。伊勒终于答应：为巴力建一座房子吧。科塔尔要给房子开一扇窗，巴力起初不肯；大火烧了六天，银子化成板、金子化成砖，宫殿建成。巴力征服了许多城市，回来后答应开窗，从云中的裂缝里发出神圣的雷声，大地震动，然后派使者去向死神穆特宣告他的王权。
summary_en: After his victory over Yamm the Sea, the storm god Baal feasts, while the warrior goddess Anat fights in the valley and then washes her hands. Baal sends messengers to bring Anat to Mount Saphon and tells her his grief: every god has a house, but Baal has none. Anat bursts in on El, father of the gods, threatening to make his grey hair run with blood, but wins no consent. Baal has the craftsman god Kothar-wa-Khasis forge a throne, a table and bowls of silver and gold as gifts for Athirat, mother of the gods. Athirat, spinning by the sea, at first fears that Baal and Anat have come to kill her sons, then rejoices at the gold and silver. She rides her donkey to El, who laughs and offers her food and drink and asks if she longs for his love; Athirat says: our king is Mightiest Baal. At last El agrees: let a house be built for Baal. Kothar wants to put a window in it, and Baal at first refuses; a fire burns six days, silver turns to plates and gold to bricks, and the palace is complete. Baal conquers many cities, returns, agrees to the window, sends his holy voice through a rift in the clouds so that the earth quakes, and sends messengers to Mot, Death, to declare his kingship.

editorial_note: 依据拉斯沙姆拉出土的巴力史诗泥板 KTU 1.3 与 1.4，按栏次顺序讲述；两块泥板都有残缺，栏次与诗行的划分据现代学者的整理，残缺处只说明而不补写。阿西拉特即后世文献中的亚舍拉，本篇按乌加里特原文称她为阿西拉特。原有的巴力与雅姆、巴力与穆特两个故事分别讲述此前和此后的泥板。

canonical_title: The Four Branches of the Mabinogi, Part 2: Branwen
title_zh: 马比诺吉昂四支 · 第二支 布兰雯
summary_zh: 不列颠的巨人国王本迪盖德弗兰把妹妹布兰雯嫁给了爱尔兰国王马索卢赫，同母异父的弟弟埃夫尼辛却残害了客人的马匹，为了赔罪，本迪盖德弗兰送出了能让死者复活的复生之釜。布兰雯在爱尔兰受尽屈辱，被罚到厨房劳作，她养了一只八哥，把信绑在它的翅膀下送回了不列颠。本迪盖德弗兰涉海而过，躺在河上为军队作桥；在百袋之屋里埃夫尼辛捏死了藏在袋中的伏兵，又把布兰雯的儿子扔进了火里；大战中，埃夫尼辛用生命撑破了复生之釜。最后只有七个人活了下来，本迪盖德弗兰命他们砍下自己的头带回伦敦，布兰雯在故乡的河边心碎而死。
summary_en: Bendigeidfran, giant king of Britain, gives his sister Branwen in marriage to Matholwch, king of Ireland, but their half-brother Efnysien maims the guest's horses, and in amends Bendigeidfran gives the cauldron of rebirth, which restores the dead to life. In Ireland Branwen is humiliated and sent to the kitchens; she rears a starling and sends it to Britain with a letter under its wing. Bendigeidfran wades across the sea and lies across a river as a bridge for his army; in the house of the hundred bags Efnysien crushes the hidden warriors and throws Branwen's son into the fire; in the war he breaks the cauldron at the cost of his life. Only seven survive; Bendigeidfran bids them cut off his head and carry it to London, and Branwen dies of a broken heart by a river of her homeland.

canonical_title: The Four Branches of the Mabinogi, Part 3: Manawydan
title_zh: 马比诺吉昂四支 · 第三支 马纳维丹
summary_zh: 从爱尔兰回来的马纳维丹发现王位已被篡夺，普雷德里把母亲里安农和达费德的七个坎特雷夫交给了他。一天，他们四人坐在阿伯斯的土丘上，一声雷响、一阵浓雾过后，整个达费德的人、房屋和牲畜都消失了，只剩下他们四个。他们到英格兰去做马鞍、盾牌和鞋子，手艺太好，惹得当地的工匠要杀他们。普雷德里和里安农追着一头白野猪走进一座神秘的城堡，被一只金碗困住，随城堡一起消失了。马纳维丹种下三块麦田，夜里麦穗被一群老鼠吃光，他捉住了一只怀孕的老鼠，要把它绞死。一位主教前来赎老鼠，马纳维丹要求的赎金是：放回里安农和普雷德里，解除达费德的魔法。原来这一切，都是为当年口袋里的獾复仇。
summary_en: Back from Ireland, Manawydan finds his throne usurped, and Pryderi gives him his mother Rhiannon and the seven cantrefs of Dyfed. As the four sit on the mound of Arberth, a peal of thunder and a mist leave Dyfed empty of people, houses and beasts, all but themselves. In England they make saddles, shields and shoes so well that the local craftsmen plot to kill them. Pryderi and Rhiannon follow a white boar into a mysterious fortress, are held fast by a golden bowl and vanish with it. Manawydan sows three fields of wheat; mice devour the ears by night, and he catches a pregnant mouse to hang it. A bishop comes to ransom the mouse, and Manawydan's price is the return of Rhiannon and Pryderi and the lifting of the enchantment on Dyfed — revenge, it turns out, for the Badger in the Bag.

canonical_title: The Four Branches of the Mabinogi, Part 4: Math
title_zh: 马比诺吉昂四支 · 第四支 马斯
summary_zh: 格温内斯的国王马斯除了打仗，必须时刻把脚放在一位少女的膝上。他的外甥吉尔维修伊爱上了这位持足少女，哥哥格威迪恩用魔法骗走了普雷德里的猪，挑起了战争，趁国王出征时让弟弟强占了少女。格威迪恩在决斗中用魔法杀死了普雷德里。马斯把两兄弟变成三对野兽惩罚了三年。阿丽安萝德在马斯的魔杖考验中生下两个孩子，却给其中一个下了三重命运：没有名字、没有武器、不能娶人间的女子。格威迪恩一次次用计破解，马斯和他用橡树花、金雀花和绣线菊造出了美丽的布罗黛维德做勒伊的妻子。可是布罗黛维德爱上了格罗努，骗出了勒伊致死的秘密，勒伊中矛化作一只鹰飞走。格威迪恩找回了勒伊，把布罗黛维德变成了猫头鹰。
summary_en: Math, king of Gwynedd, must keep his feet in a maiden's lap except in war. His nephew Gilfaethwy desires the footholder, and Gwydion tricks Pryderi out of his swine to start a war, so that Gilfaethwy can violate her while the king is away; Gwydion kills Pryderi in single combat by magic. Math punishes the brothers by turning them into three pairs of beasts for three years. Arianrhod, stepping over Math's wand, drops two children and lays three destinies on one: no name, no arms, no wife of the human race. Gwydion outwits each, and he and Math make the beautiful Blodeuedd from the flowers of oak, broom and meadowsweet as Lleu's wife. But she loves Gronw Pebr and draws from Lleu the secret of his death; struck by a spear, Lleu flies away as an eagle. Gwydion finds and heals him and turns Blodeuedd into an owl.

canonical_title: The Four Branches of the Mabinogi, Part 1: Pwyll
title_zh: 马比诺吉昂四支 · 第一支 皮威尔
summary_zh: 达费德王子皮威尔在打猎时冒犯了彼世安农的国王阿拉文，为了赔罪，他与阿拉文交换容貌和王国一年，替他在浅滩上一击杀死了宿敌哈夫甘，一年里对阿拉文的王后秋毫无犯，从此被称为“安农之主”。他在阿伯斯的土丘上遇见了骑白马的里安农，她抛弃了原来的婚约选择了他；皮威尔一句轻率的许诺差点失去她，又用一只魔法口袋把情敌骗了进去。他们的儿子在出生的夜里失踪了，侍女们诬陷里安农吃掉了孩子，里安农被罚在宫门边驮客七年；直到邻国的领主泰尔农发现了他在马厩边捡到的孩子，金发的男孩才回到母亲身边，被取名为普雷德里。
summary_en: Out hunting, Pwyll, prince of Dyfed, offends Arawn, king of the Otherworld Annwn, and in amends exchanges shapes and kingdoms with him for a year, killing Arawn's rival Hafgan with a single blow at the ford and keeping chaste with Arawn's queen, so that he is called Head of Annwn. On the mound of Arberth he meets Rhiannon on her white horse, who chooses him over her betrothed; he almost loses her through a rash promise and wins her back by trapping his rival in a magic bag. Their son vanishes on the night of his birth, the waiting-women accuse Rhiannon of devouring him, and she is condemned to carry visitors at the gate for seven years — until Teyrnon, who found a child by his stable, brings the golden-haired boy home, and he is named Pryderi.

canonical_title: Mithra of the wide pastures — the Mihr Yasht
title_zh: 广阔牧场之主密特拉：《密赫尔颂》
summary_zh: 阿维斯塔第十颂《密赫尔颂》：阿胡拉·马兹达说，他创造密特拉时，使他与自己同样值得祭祀和祈祷；对密特拉说谎、背弃契约的人会给整个国家带来死亡；密特拉有千只耳朵、万只眼睛，在不朽的快马太阳之前最先越过哈拉山。
summary_en: The Mihr Yasht, tenth hymn of the Avesta: Ahura Mazda says he made Mithra as worthy of sacrifice and prayer as himself; whoever lies to Mithra and breaks the contract brings death to the whole land; Mithra has a thousand ears and ten thousand eyes and is the first god to rise over Mount Hara, before the swift-horsed sun.

canonical_title: Sixteen good lands and their plagues — Videvdad 1
title_zh: 十六片良地与它们的灾祸：《万迪达德》第一章
summary_zh: 《万迪达德》第一章：阿胡拉·马兹达创造了十六片良地，第一片是善河岱提亚旁的雅利安瓦伊贾；每创造一片，“全然是死亡”的安格拉·曼纽就造出一种灾祸与之对抗——第一片是河中之蛇和寒冬，第二片是蝗虫。
summary_en: Videvdad 1: Ahura Mazda makes sixteen good lands, the first being Airyana Vaejah by the good river Daitya; for each, Angra Mainyu, who is all death, counter-creates a plague — the serpent in the river and winter for the first, the locust for the second.
